title: CanvasComposer：基于多参考画布的个性化合影生成
title_en: CanvasComposer: Personalized Group Photo Generation via a Multi-Reference Canvas
abstract: 现有的个性化图像生成器在自然、协调的多人生成中仍难以保持多个参考身份。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CanvasComposer，一个用于个性化合影生成的交互式框架。受专业图像编辑软件启发，CanvasComposer 允许用户把参考主体放置在共享画布上，每个主体保留其输入图像的 RGBA 抠图。这种多参考画布在重叠情况下仍能保留参考内容，同时为组织多个身份提供了直观界面：各主体在输入画布上仍是彼此独立的元素，而模型输出一张统一的、经过协调的个性化图像。为保持该表示的高效性，透明潜变量剪枝仅保留每个主体非透明区域的 token；跨参考训练则通过让模型学会协调来自不同图像的参考，缓解复制粘贴伪影。大量实验表明，与多人物个性化图像生成的现有最优方法相比，CanvasComposer 能实现连贯的生成与更强的身份保持能力。项目主页：https://snap-research.github.io/canvascomposer
abstract_en: Existing personalized image generators still struggle to preserve multiple reference identities in natural and coherent multi-human generations. To address these limitations, we present CanvasComposer, an interactive framework for personalized group photo generation. Inspired by professional image-editing software, CanvasComposer allows users to place reference subjects on a shared canvas, where each subject keeps its own RGBA cutout of the input. This multi-reference canvas preserves reference content under overlap while providing an intuitive interface for organizing multiple identities; the subjects remain separate elements on the input canvas, and the model outputs a single personalized and harmonized image. To keep this representation efficient, transparent latent pruning retains only tokens from each subject's non-transparent region, and cross-reference training mitigates copy-paste artifacts by learning to harmonize references sampled from different images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CanvasComposer achieves coherent generation and strong identity preservation compared to state-of-the-art methods in multi-human personalized image generation. Project page: https://snap-research.github.io/canvascomposer
keywords: Computer Vision;Avatar / Human;Image Generation / Editing
authors: Gordon Guocheng Qian, Ruihang Zhang, Tsai-Shien Chen, Yusuf Dalva, Anujraaj Argo Goyal, Willi Menapace, Ivan Skorokhodov, Meng Dong, Arpit Sahni, Daniil Ostashev, Ju Hu, Mukesh Singhal, Sergey Tulyakov, Kuan-Chieh Jackson Wang

title: CoatFusion：图像中的可控材质涂覆
title_en: CoatFusion: Controllable Material Coating in Images
abstract: 我们提出“材质涂覆”（Material Coating）这一新的图像编辑任务：在物体表面模拟施加一层薄材质，同时保留其底层粗、细几何结构。材质涂覆与现有“材质迁移”方法有本质区别——后者旨在替换物体的固有材质，往往会覆盖掉细节。针对这一新任务，我们构建了名为 DataCoat110K 的大规模合成数据集（11 万张图像），其中包含具有多种基于物理的涂层的三维物体。随后我们提出 CoatFusion，一种新颖的架构：以二维反照率纹理以及细粒度的 PBR 风格参数化控制（包括粗糙度、金属度、透射率和一个关键的厚度参数）共同作为扩散模型的条件，从而实现该任务。实验与用户研究表明，CoatFusion 能生成真实且可控的涂层，在这一新任务上显著优于现有的材质编辑与材质迁移方法。
abstract_en: We introduce Material Coating, a novel image editing task that simulates applying a thin material layer onto an object while preserving its underlying coarse and fine geometry. Material coating is fundamentally different from existing "material transfer" methods, which are designed to replace an object's intrinsic material, often overwriting fine details. To address this new task, we construct a large-scale synthetic dataset (110K images) of 3D objects with varied, physically-based coatings, named DataCoat110K. We then propose CoatFusion, a novel architecture that enables this task by conditioning a diffusion model on both a 2D albedo texture and granular, PBR-style parametric controls, including roughness, metalness, transmission, and a key thickness parameter. Experiments and user studies show CoatFusion produces realistic, controllable coatings and significantly outperforms existing material editing and transfer methods on this new task.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;Machine Learning;Diffusion Model;Physics Simulation;CAD / Modeling;Image Generation / Editing
authors: Sagie Levy, Elad Aharoni, Matan Levy, Ariel Shamir, Dani Lischinski

title: CADKnitter：文本与几何引导的组合式 CAD 生成
title_en: CADKnitter: Compositional CAD Generation from Text and Geometry Guidance
abstract: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）用紧凑、精确且可编辑的表示来定义三维模型，因此在多个领域都有直接用途。近来，CAD 生成在研究界与工业界都受到更多关注。创作 CAD 模型长期是一项费时费力的工作，要求设计者兼具精确性与专业经验。已有工作在单部件 CAD 生成上取得了初步成功，但这并不适合真实应用，因为多个部件需要在语义约束与几何兼容性下装配在一起。本文提出 CADKnitter，一个带几何引导线索、用于引导扩散采样的组合式 CAD 生成框架。CADKnitter 能够生成互补的 CAD 部件，同时遵循给定 CAD 模型的几何约束与目标设计文本提示的语义约束。我们还构建了名为 KnitCAD 的数据集，包含 31 万余个 CAD 模型样本，以及提供语义与几何约束的文本提示和装配元数据。大量实验表明，我们的方法以明显优势优于其他最先进的基线。项目主页：https://cadknitter.github.io/
abstract_en: Computer-aided design (CAD) defines 3D models as compact, precise, and editable representations, making it directly useful for several fields. Recently, CAD generation has been gaining more attention in both the research community and industry. Crafting CAD models has long been a painstaking and time-intensive task, demanding both precision and expertise from designers. Prior works have achieved early success in single-part CAD generation, which is not well-suited for real-world applications, as multiple parts need to be assembled under semantic constraints and geometric compatibility. In this paper, we propose CADKnitter, a compositional CAD generation framework with geometric-guiding cues to steer diffusion sampling. CADKnitter is able to generate a complementary CAD part that follows both the geometric constraints of the given CAD model and the semantic constraints of the desired design text prompt. We also curate a dataset, so-called KnitCAD, containing over 310,000 samples of CAD models, along with textual prompts and assembly metadata that provide semantic and geometric constraints. Intensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms other state-of-the-art baselines by a clear margin. Our project page is available at https://cadknitter.github.io/.
keywords: Computer Vision;Machine Learning;Diffusion Model;CAD / Modeling;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Tri Le, Khang Nguyen, Baoru Huang, Tung D. Ta, Anh Nguyen

title: 各向异性格林坐标
title_en: Anisotropic Green Coordinates
abstract: 我们生活在一个充满各向异性的世界中，这是自然系统与人造系统共有的普遍特征。本研究聚焦空间变形，提出各向异性格林坐标（AGC），为二维与三维中基于笼架的变形和变分变形提供了灵活多样的效果。AGC 由各向异性拉普拉斯方程 ∇·(A∇ u)=0 导出，其中 A 为对称正定（SPD）矩阵。基于该方程，我们建立了边界积分表述，并将其离散化，从而得到定义在有向单纯形笼架的顶点与法向上的变形坐标。我们的方法满足线性再现性与平移不变性等基本性质，并在二维与三维情形下都具有闭式表达。我们还给出了该方法的直观几何解释，说明它能生成拟共形映射。我们从理论与实验两方面证明：当笼架面的法向与 A 较大特征值对应的特征向量对齐时，变形效果更为显著。这表明各向异性放大了沿该方向的变形敏感度，从而支持更有针对性的笼架设计与矩阵选择。此外，我们推导了变形坐标的梯度与 Hessian，并采用局部—全局优化框架实现变分形状变形，在获得尽可能刚体（ARAP）变形的同时实现灵活的形状操控。实验结果表明，AGC 提供了灵活多样的变形选项，为艺术家带来更强的自由度，也为空间变形引入了新的视角。
abstract_en: We live in a world filled with anisotropy, a ubiquitous characteristic of both natural and engineered systems. In this study, we concentrate on space deformation and introduce Anisotropic Green Coordinates (AGC), which provide versatile effects for cage-based and variational deformations in both two and three dimensions. The AGC are derived from the anisotropic Laplace equation $\nabla\cdot(\mathbf{A}\nabla u)=0$, where $\mathbf{A}$ is a symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix. Based on this equation, we establish the boundary integral formulation, which is subsequently discretized to derive the deformation coordinates defined on the vertices and normals of oriented simplicial cages. Our method satisfies basic properties such as linear reproduction and translation invariance, and possesses closed-form expressions for both 2D and 3D scenarios. We also give an intuitive geometric interpretation of the approach, demonstrating that our method can generate a quasi-conformal mapping. We demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that the deformation effect is more pronounced when the normal of the cage face aligns with the eigenvector corresponding to the larger eigenvalue of $\mathbf{A}$. This indicates that anisotropy amplifies the deformation sensitivity along this direction, enabling more targeted cage design and matrix selection. Furthermore, we derive the gradients and Hessians of the deformation coordinates and employ the local-global optimization framework to facilitate variational shape deformation, enabling flexible shape manipulation while achieving as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) shape deformation. Experimental results demonstrate that AGC offer versatile and diverse deformation options, providing artists with enhanced flexibility and introducing a novel perspective on spatial deformation.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Physics Simulation;Geometry Processing
authors: Dong Xiao, Renjie Chen, Bailin Deng

title: 超越像素：基于图式驱动的智能体推理的视觉隐喻迁移
title_en: Beyond Pixels: Visual Metaphor Transfer via Schema-Driven Agentic Reasoning
abstract: 视觉隐喻是人类创造力的一种高阶形式，它借助跨域语义融合把抽象概念转化为有冲击力的视觉修辞。尽管生成式 AI 取得了显著进展，现有模型仍基本局限于像素级的指令对齐与表观层面的外观保持，无法捕捉真正隐喻生成所需的底层抽象逻辑。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出视觉隐喻迁移（Visual Metaphor Transfer, VMT）任务，要求模型自主地从参考图像中解耦出“创意本质”，并把这一抽象逻辑重新物化到用户指定的目标主体上。我们提出一个受认知科学启发的多智能体框架，通过一种新的“图式语法”（Schema Grammar，“G”）把概念整合理论（CBT）付诸实现。这种结构化表示将关系不变量与具体视觉实体解耦，为跨域逻辑的重新实例化提供了严格基础。我们的流程由多个专门化智能体协同完成 VMT：感知智能体把参考提炼为图式；迁移智能体在保持类属空间不变的前提下寻找合适的载体；生成智能体负责高保真合成；分层诊断智能体则模仿专业评论者，通过闭环回溯在抽象逻辑、组件选择与提示编码三个层面识别并纠正错误。大量实验与人工评测表明，我们的方法在隐喻一致性、类比恰当性与视觉创造力上显著优于当前最优基线，为广告与媒体领域自动化的高影响力创意应用开辟了道路。含源码与自包含技能的项目主页：https://yuci-gpt.github.io/Beyond-Pixels/
abstract_en: A visual metaphor constitutes a high-order form of human creativity, employing cross-domain semantic fusion to transform abstract concepts into impactful visual rhetoric. Despite the remarkable progress of generative AI, existing models remain largely confined to pixel-level instruction alignment and surface-level appearance preservation, failing to capture the underlying abstract logic necessary for genuine metaphorical generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce the task of Visual Metaphor Transfer (VMT), which challenges models to autonomously decouple the "creative essence" from a reference image and re-materialize that abstract logic onto a user-specified target subject. We propose a cognitive-inspired, multi-agent framework that operationalizes Conceptual Blending Theory (CBT) through a novel Schema Grammar ("G"). This structured representation decouples relational invariants from specific visual entities, providing a rigorous foundation for cross-domain logic re-instantiation. Our pipeline executes VMT through a collaborative system of specialized agents: a perception agent that distills the reference into a schema, a transfer agent that maintains generic space invariance to discover apt carriers, a generation agent for high-fidelity synthesis and a hierarchical diagnostic agent that mimics a professional critic, performing closed-loop backtracking to identify and rectify errors across abstract logic, component selection, and prompt encoding. Extensive experiments and human evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms SOTA baselines in metaphor consistency, analogy appropriateness, and visual creativity, paving the way for automated high-impact creative applications in advertising and media. Project page with source code and self-contained skills is at https://yuci-gpt.github.io/Beyond-Pixels/.
keywords: Computer Vision;Artificial Intelligence;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Yu Xu, Yuxin Zhang, Lin Gao, Oliver Deussen, Tong-Yee Lee, Fan Tang

title: ProAct：融合流式动作生成与智能体推理的实时具身社交交互
title_en: ProAct: Harnessing Streaming Motion Generation and Agentic Reasoning for Real-Time Embodied Social Interaction
abstract: 实时具身社交交互对智能体提出了两项同等严苛的要求：一是持续生成流畅的多模态交互行为；二是对累积的对话与视觉上下文进行主动推理，以判断何时应当主动发起交互。这两项要求都必须在严格的时延预算内同时满足，因而很难兼顾。我们提出 ProAct，一个双系统框架，通过把一个低时延的行为系统（负责流式多模态交互）与一个较慢的认知系统（负责长程社交推理并产生高层主动意图）相结合，来应对这些时间敏感的需求。认知系统包含高效的记忆机制与用户动机预测模块，用以对累积的对话和视觉上下文进行推理，判断何时适合主动介入。行为系统进一步包含一个意图条件化的流式流匹配动作生成器，并配有解耦的 ControlNet 分支，可把审慎的意图转化为连续的非言语行为，而不破坏交互的流畅性。我们把 ProAct 部署在实体人形机器人上，并通过全面实验验证该框架，包括真实用户研究、动作生成基准测试，以及在 ProActBench（一个用于评估具身交互中主动触发检测与克制的新基准）上的评测。
abstract_en: Real-time embodied social interaction places two equally demanding requirements on an agent: continuously generating fluent multimodal interaction behavior, and proactively reasoning over accumulated dialogue and visual context to decide when to take initiative. These requirements must both be satisfied under a strict latency budget, making them difficult to meet simultaneously. We present ProAct, a dual-system framework that manages these time-critical requirements by integrating a low-latency Behavioral System for streaming multimodal interaction with a slower Cognitive System that performs long-horizon social reasoning and produces high-level proactive intentions. The Cognitive System incorporates an efficient memory mechanism and a user-motivation prediction module to reason over accumulated dialogue and visual context and determine when proactive intervention is appropriate. The Behavioral System further includes an intention-conditioned streaming flow-matching motion generator with a disentangled ControlNet branch, which translates deliberative intentions into continuous non-verbal behavior without disrupting interaction fluency. We deploy ProAct on a physical humanoid robot and validate the framework through comprehensive experiments, including real-world user studies, motion-generation benchmarks, and evaluation on ProActBench, a new, targeted benchmark for evaluating proactive trigger detection and restraint in embodied interaction.
keywords: Robotics;Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Zeyi Zhang, Zixi Kang, Ruijie Zhao, Yusen Feng, Biao Jiang, Hanyu Ji, Libin Liu

title: 无需光谱渲染器的光谱渲染：面向 RGB 管线的可学习光谱编码
title_en: Spectral Rendering Without a Spectral Renderer: Learned Spectral Codes for RGB Pipelines
abstract: 光谱渲染能够再现 RGB 渲染无法表现的光谱相关外观：同色异谱、丰富光谱光照下的颜色偏移、有色玻璃、金属反射以及次表面散射。它需要具备光谱感知能力的渲染器，但渲染生态绝大多数是 RGB 的：游戏引擎、云端渲染农场、GPU 光栅化器以及多数离线渲染器只接受 RGB 输入，无法访问光谱渲染所依赖的内部波长传播过程。我们提出可学习光谱编码（learned spectral codes）——一种紧凑的线性表示，可在不作修改的 RGB 管线中实现通用的光谱渲染。训练好的编码器把任意可见光范围内的光谱量压缩为一个小隐向量；这些编码被打包为 RGB 三元组，交由现成的 RGB 渲染器处理。该编解码器保持了光传输的算术性质——对缩放与加法精确成立，对逐元素乘积近似成立——因此两次标准 RGB 渲染即可得到与完整光谱渲染高度接近的结果。同一编解码器可处理反射率、光照、有色玻璃、导体与参与介质：一条管线贯通各类材质，且渲染器无需针对材质做任何修改。在缺乏光谱资产数据时，轻量神经上采样器可把传统 RGB 输入桥接到隐空间。在多样材质与光照下，本方法在 RGB 渲染失败最明显的场景中带来显著的质量提升，渲染代价与高效的光谱采样技术相当，且无需改动渲染器。
abstract_en: Spectral rendering reproduces the wavelength-dependent appearance that RGB rendering cannot: metamerism, colour shifts under spectrally rich illumination, coloured glass, metallic reflection and subsurface scattering. It requires a spectrally aware renderer, but the rendering ecosystem is predominantly RGB: game engines, cloud render farms, GPU rasterisers and most offline renderers consume RGB alone, with no access to the internal wavelength propagation that spectral rendering relies on. We introduce learned spectral codes, a compact linear representation that enables general spectral rendering through unmodified RGB pipelines. A trained encoder compresses any visible-range spectral quantity into a small latent vector; the codes are packed as RGB triplets and processed by an off-the-shelf RGB renderer. The codec preserves the arithmetic of light transport, exactly for scaling and addition and approximately for element-wise products, so two standard RGB passes suffice to produce results closely matching a full spectral rendering. The same codec handles reflectance, illumination, coloured glass, conductors, and participating media: one pipeline across material classes, with no per-material modification to the renderer. Where spectral asset data is unavailable, lightweight neural upsamplers bridge legacy RGB inputs to the latent space. Across diverse materials and illumination, the method yields substantial quality improvements on the cases where RGB rendering fails most visibly, at rendering cost comparable to efficient spectral-sampling techniques and with no changes to the renderer.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;Material / BRDF;Lighting / Illumination;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling;Optics / Display
authors: Jiaqi Yu, Dar'ya Guarnera, Giuseppe Claudio Guarnera

title: RecGen3D：共享规范空间中的重建引导三维生成
title_en: RecGen3D: Reconstruction-Guided 3D Generation in a Shared Canonical Space
abstract: 稀疏视角三维建模体现了重建保真度与生成合理性之间的根本张力。前馈重建在效率与输入对齐上表现出色，但往往缺乏实现结构完整性所需的全局先验；相反，基于扩散的生成能提供丰富的几何细节，却难以保证多视角一致性。我们提出 RecGen3D，一个把这两种范式结合为协作系统的框架。为克服坐标空间、三维表示与训练目标上的固有冲突，我们把两个模型对齐到同一共享规范空间之中。我们采用解耦的协同学习，既保持训练稳定，又能在推理时实现无缝协作。具体而言，重建模块被改造为提供规范几何锚点，而扩散生成器则利用潜变量增强的条件化来细化并补全几何结构。实验结果表明，RecGen3D 具有更优的保真度与鲁棒性，在从稀疏观测创建完整、一致的三维模型方面优于现有方法。
abstract_en: Sparse-view 3D modeling represents a fundamental tension between reconstruction fidelity and generative plausibility. While feed-forward reconstruction excels in efficiency and input alignment, it often lacks the global priors needed for structural completeness. Conversely, diffusion-based generation provides rich geometric details but struggles with multi-view consistency. We present RecGen3D, a framework that combines these two paradigms into a cooperative system. To overcome inherent conflicts in coordinate spaces, 3D representations, and training objectives, we align both models within a shared canonical space. We employ decoupled cooperative learning, which maintains stable training while enabling seamless collaboration during inference. Specifically, the reconstruction module is adapted to provide canonical geometric anchors, while the diffusion generator leverages latent-augmented conditioning to refine and complete the geometric structure. Experimental results demonstrate that RecGen3D achieves superior fidelity and robustness, outperforming existing methods in creating complete and consistent 3D models from sparse observations.
keywords: Computer Vision;Diffusion Model;3D Reconstruction;CAD / Modeling;3D Generation
authors: Zhisheng Huang, Jiahao Chen, Cheng Lin, Chenyu Hu, Hanzhuo Huang, Zhengming Yu, Mengfei Li, Yuheng Liu, Zekai Gu, Zibo Zhao, Yuan Liu, Xin Li, Wenping Wang

title: GaussiAnimate：构建带动态层次的类别级可动画绑定
title_en: GaussiAnimate: Rig Animatable Categories with Level of Dynamics
abstract: 我们提出 Skelebones——一个“支架—蒙皮”绑定系统，分三步构建：（1）Bones 把时间一致的高斯或网格序列压缩为自由形态的骨骼（bones），并配以平滑的蒙皮权重，通过线性混合蒙皮（LBS）近似非刚性变形；（2）Skeleton 从规范形状中提取平均曲率骨架（MCS），并在时间维度上把其拓扑与运动学精化为紧凑的骨架结构；（3）Binding 通过非参数化的分部位动作匹配（PartMM）连接骨架与骨骼——PartMM 通过匹配、检索与混合已有骨骼运动来合成新的骨骼运动。三步合起来把四维形状的动态压缩为紧凑的 skelebones，使其同时具备可控性与表现力。所得表示与类别无关（即无需模板）、运动自适应（拓扑是动态的），且拓扑正确（骨架与表面几何一致）。PartMM 无需任何学习。我们在合成与真实数据集上验证了该方法，在未见过的姿态上取得显著的再动画提升：在 DNA-Rendering 上相对 LBS 提升 17.3 dB PSNR，在 ActorsHQ 上相对 Bag-of-Bones 提升 45.6 dB，同时对具有复杂非刚性动态的角色保持了高渲染保真度。PartMM 可稳健泛化到高斯与网格两种表示，在约 1000 帧的低数据条件下表现尤为突出：相对 LBS 的 RMSE 改善 48.4，相对基于 GRU 与 MLP 的方法改善超过 20。代码将发布于 https://cookmaker.cn/gaussianimate/。
abstract_en: We propose Skelebones, a Scaffold-Skin Rigging System built on three steps: (1) Bones compress temporally consistent Gaussian or mesh sequences into free-form bones with smooth skinning weights, approximating non-rigid deformations via linear blend skinning (LBS); (2) Skeleton extracts the Mean Curvature Skeleton (MCS) from the canonical shape and temporally refines its topology and kinematics into a compact skeletal structure; and (3) Binding connects the skeleton and bones through non-parametric Partwise Motion Matching (PartMM), which synthesizes novel bone motions by matching, retrieving, and blending existing ones. Together, these steps compress the dynamics of 4D shapes into compact skelebones that are simultaneously controllable and expressive. The resulting representation is category-agnostic, meaning template-free; motion-adaptive, with dynamic topology; and topology-correct, with a skeleton consistent with the surface geometry. PartMM requires no learning. We validate our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets, achieving substantial reanimation improvements on unseen poses: a 17.3 dB PSNR gain over LBS on DNA-Rendering and a 45.6 dB gain over Bag-of-Bones on ActorsHQ, while preserving high rendering fidelity for characters with complex non-rigid dynamics. PartMM generalizes robustly to both Gaussian and mesh representations, excelling in low-data regimes of approximately 1,000 frames, with a 48.4 RMSE improvement over LBS and improvements of more than 20 over GRU- and MLP-based methods. Code will be publicly released at https://cookmaker.cn/gaussianimate/.

authors: Jiaxin Wang, Dongxin Lyu, Zeyu Cai, Zhiyang Dou, Cheng Lin, Anpei Chen, Yuliang Xiu

title: MoCapAnything V2：面向任意骨架的端到端动作捕捉
title_en: MoCapAnything V2: End-to-End Motion Capture for Arbitrary Skeletons
abstract: 近来从单目视频进行任意骨架动作捕捉的方法采用分解式流程：由 Video-to-Pose 网络预测关节位置，再由解析的逆运动学（IK）阶段恢复关节旋转。该设计虽有效，却有内在局限：关节位置并不能完全确定旋转，会留下诸如骨骼轴向扭转等自由度上的歧义；而不可微的 IK 阶段又使系统无法适应带噪预测，也无法针对最终动画目标进行优化。本文提出首个完全端到端的框架，使 Video-to-Pose 与 Pose-to-Rotation 均可学习并联合优化。我们观察到，姿态到旋转映射的歧义源于坐标系信息的缺失：相同的关节位置在不同静置姿态与局部轴向约定下可对应不同的旋转。为解决此问题，我们从目标资产中引入一对参考姿态—旋转，它与静置姿态一起不仅锚定了映射，还定义了底层的旋转坐标系。这一表述把旋转预测转化为一个约束良好的条件问题，从而使有效学习成为可能。此外，我们的模型直接从视频预测关节位置，不依赖网格中间表示，从而提升了鲁棒性与效率。两个阶段共享一个骨架感知的全局—局部图引导多头注意力（GL-GMHA）模块，用于关节级的局部推理与全局协调。在 Truebones Zoo 与 Objaverse 上的实验表明，本方法把旋转误差从约 17 度降至约 10 度，在未见骨架上降至 6.54 度，同时推理速度比基于网格的流程快约 20 倍。项目主页：https://animotionlab.github.io/MoCapAnythingV2/
abstract_en: Recent methods for arbitrary-skeleton motion capture from monocular video follow a factorized pipeline, where a Video-to-Pose network predicts joint positions and an analytical inverse-kinematics (IK) stage recovers joint rotations. While effective, this design is inherently limited, since joint positions do not fully determine rotations and leave degrees of freedom such as bone-axis twist ambiguous, and the non-differentiable IK stage prevents the system from adapting to noisy predictions or optimizing for the final animation objective. In this work, we present the first fully end-to-end framework in which both Video-to-Pose and Pose-to-Rotation are learnable and jointly optimized. We observe that the ambiguity in pose-to-rotation mapping arises from missing coordinate system information: the same joint positions can correspond to different rotations under different rest poses and local axis conventions. To resolve this, we introduce a reference pose-rotation pair from the target asset, which, together with the rest pose, not only anchors the mapping but also defines the underlying rotation coordinate system. This formulation turns rotation prediction into a well-constrained conditional problem and enables effective learning. In addition, our model predicts joint positions directly from video without relying on mesh intermediates, improving both robustness and efficiency. Both stages share a skeleton-aware Global-Local Graph-guided Multi-Head Attention (GL-GMHA) module for joint-level local reasoning and global coordination. Experiments on Truebones Zoo and Objaverse show that our method reduces rotation error from ~17 degrees to ~10 degrees, and to 6.54 degrees on unseen skeletons, while achieving ~20x faster inference than mesh-based pipelines.
