authors: Kehong Gong, Zhengyu Wen, Dao Thien Phong, Mingxi Xu, Weixia He, Qi Wang, Ning Zhang, Zhengyu Li, Guanli Hou, Dongze Lian, Xiaoyu He, Mingyuan Zhang, Hanwang Zhang

title: OffsetAxis：通过偏移体中轴提取的 UDF 网格重建
title_en: OffsetAxis: UDF Mesh Reconstruction via Offset-Volume Medial Axis Extraction
abstract: 无符号距离场（UDF）比有符号距离场（SDF）具备更广的建模能力，可表示带开放边界、非流形结构或曲线与曲面混合部件的形状。然而，从 UDF 中提取连贯网格本质上更难：经典的基于网格的等值面技术不再适用，因为它们需要能够区分形状的内外。我们提出 OffsetAxis，一条新的 UDF 重建流程，支持开放、非流形与类曲线的几何。我们的关键洞见是：0 等值面提取问题可以重新表述为提取 UDF 的 α 偏移体的中轴。这一表述释放了成熟的中轴工具，可自然支持边界、非流形交汇与曲线。为避免基于网格技术带来的偏差，我们用光线投射对 α 偏移面进行采样，并用变分中轴采样的一种高效变体在偏移体内部优化中轴球。最终网格通过取中轴球簇连通性的对偶得到，从而在广泛的拓扑上产生结构连贯的重建。该方法的鲁棒性与通用性使其能处理不完美的距离场，包括在含噪输入上训练的神经 UDF、准中轴距离场（Q-MDF），以及直接在三角面片汤或点云上计算的距离。大量实验表明，与既有技术相比，我们的方法能产生更忠实的网格重建，并与底层形状结构更好地对齐。
abstract_en: Unsigned distance fields (UDFs) offer broader modeling capabilities than signed distance fields (SDFs), enabling the representation of shapes with open boundaries, non-manifold structures or mixed curve and surface parts. However, extracting coherent meshes from UDFs is fundamentally harder, as classical grid-based iso-surfacing techniques are not applicable since they require a way to distinguish the inside from the outside of the shape. We introduce OffsetAxis, a new UDF reconstruction pipeline that supports open, non-manifold, and curve-like geometries. Our key insight is that the 0-level set extraction problem can be restated as the extraction of the medial axis of the $α$-offset volume of the UDF. This formulation unlocks mature medial-axis machinery that naturally supports boundaries, non-manifold junctions and curves. To avoid the biases of grid-based techniques, we sample the $α$-offset surface using ray casting and optimize medial balls inside the offset volume with an efficient variant of Variational Medial Axis Sampling. The final mesh is recovered by taking the dual of the connectivity of the medial ball clusters, producing structurally coherent reconstructions for a wide range of topologies. The robustness and versatility of the approach allow it to handle imperfect distance fields, including neural UDFs trained on noisy inputs, the Quasi-Medial Distance Field (Q-MDF), as well as distances computed directly on triangle soups or point clouds. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces more faithful mesh reconstruction and better alignment with the underlying shape structure than prior techniques.
keywords: Computer Graphics;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;CAD / Modeling;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Qijia Huang, Pierre Kraemer, Dominique Bechmann

title: 实时神经毛发 G-Buffer 抗锯齿
title_en: Real-Time Neural Hair G-Buffer Anti-Aliasing
abstract: 我们提出一种轻量级的实时方法，用于从采样严重不足的光栅化输入重建基于发丝的毛发 G-Buffer。我们的流程首先应用神经空间重建与时间累积，恢复毛发覆盖率（即像素内毛发的分数可见度）与切线；随后用切线引导的重建步骤补全位置，该位置进而用于基于物理的延迟毛发着色。我们在包含直发、卷发、爆炸头与马尾等多种发型的数据集上，于静态与动态场景中评估了本方法。相比 DLSS、FSR 等通用工业级神经重建方案，我们的方法取得了更高的毛发重建质量。
abstract_en: We propose a lightweight real-time method for reconstructing strand-based hair G-Buffers from severely undersampled rasterized inputs. Our pipeline first applies neural spatial reconstruction and temporal accumulation to recover hair coverage, i.e., fractional hair visibility within a pixel, and tangent. It then uses a tangent-guided reconstruction step to complete the position, which is subsequently used for physically based deferred hair shading. We evaluate our method across a diverse set of hairstyles, including straight, wavy, afro, and ponytail styles, under both static and dynamic scenarios. Our method achieves higher hair reconstruction quality than general industrial neural reconstruction solutions such as DLSS and FSR.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;3D Reconstruction;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Chenghao Wu, Yuefan Shen, Tao Huang, Kai Yan, Zahra Montazeri, Kui Wu

title: PureLight：用光源追踪学习复杂灯具外观
title_en: PureLight: Learning Complex Luminaires with Light Tracing
abstract: 我们提出一种用于估计复杂灯具外观的神经表述。我们关注具有复杂光传输的困难灯具（例如被多层镜面层包裹的小型发光体），这类灯具对（双向）路径追踪而言十分棘手。为此，我们使用光源追踪来构建从发光体到出射表面的路径，并把外观估计表述为一个分布学习问题。具体而言，我们用大型归一化流网络建模出射表面上出射辐亮的概率密度函数（pdf），并以估计的 pdf 与通量的乘积恢复出射辐亮。为支持高效推理，我们把学到的外观蒸馏进一个轻量 MLP，直接估计出射表面上的辐亮。我们还训练了一个采样网络用于高效计算来自该灯具的直接光照，以及一个融合网络把灯具合成到场景中。该表述使得在任意场景中以低采样数渲染困难灯具成为可行。代码见 https://github.com/pedrovfigueiredo/purelight。
abstract_en: We propose a neural formulation for estimating the appearance of complex luminaires. We focus on challenging luminaires with complex light transport (e.g., small emitters enclosed by multiple specular layers) that are difficult for (bidirectional) path tracing. To this end, we use light tracing to construct paths from emitters to the exit surfaces and formulate appearance estimation as a distribution learning problem. Specifically, we model the probability density function (pdf) of outgoing radiance on the exit surfaces using a large normalizing flow network, and recover the outgoing radiance as the product of the estimated pdf and flux. To enable efficient inference, we distill the learned appearance into a lightweight MLP that directly estimates radiance on the exit surfaces. We additionally train a sampling network for effective direct illumination computation from the luminaire, and a blending network to composite the luminaire into the scene. Our formulation makes it feasible to render challenging luminaires using low sample counts in arbitrary scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/pedrovfigueiredo/purelight.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;Relighting;Lighting / Illumination;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Pedro Figueiredo, Zixuan Li, Beibei Wang, Miloš Hašan, Nima Khademi Kalantari

title: Artic-O：基于隐几何学习的端到端铰接物体重建
title_en: Artic-O: End-to-End Articulated Object Reconstruction via Latent Geometry Learning
abstract: 从稀疏图像重建铰接物体，需要同时恢复完整几何、可动部件与运动参数。近期方法通常把几何重建、部件推理与铰接估计拆成不同阶段，这种拆分既会削弱形状、活动部件与运动之间的一致性，也会带来可观的推理开销。我们提出 Artic-O，一个通过隐几何学习实现铰接物体重建的端到端前馈框架。Artic-O 不在图像空间或视角空间中拟合几何，而是把稀疏的多状态观测映射进一个预训练的隐几何空间，其中冻结的流匹配解码器提供完整形状先验，用于恢复可见与遮挡结构。为把几何与铰接联系起来，Artic-O 在一个以图像为基准的部件推理模块中融合视觉 token、几何潜变量与逐点解码器特征，用于活动部件分割与铰接预测。我们进一步用“几何到铰接”的课程学习以及解耦的两遍策略来训练模型，以平衡重建监督与部件级监督。在 PartNet-Mobility 上，Artic-O 取得了很强的重建质量，同时比强先验方法 LARM 高效得多：它降低了 Chamfer 距离、提升了 F-score，在多数关节指标上取得相当或更好的铰接精度，并把每物体的推理时间从 9 分钟缩短到约 0.3 秒。
abstract_en: Reconstructing articulated objects from sparse images requires recovering complete geometry, movable parts, and motion parameters. Recent methods typically separate geometry reconstruction, part reasoning, and articulation estimation into different stages. This separation can weaken consistency between shape, active parts, and motion, while also incurring substantial inference cost. We introduce Artic-O, an end-to-end, feed-forward framework for articulated object reconstruction via latent geometry learning. Instead of fitting geometry in image or view space, Artic-O maps sparse multi-state observations into a pretrained latent geometry space, where a frozen flow-matching decoder provides a complete-shape prior for recovering visible and occluded structures. To connect geometry with articulation, Artic-O fuses visual tokens, geometry latents, and point-wise decoder features in an image-grounded part-reasoning module for active-part segmentation and articulation prediction. We further train the model with a geometry-to-articulation curriculum and a decoupled two-pass strategy to balance reconstruction and part-level supervision. On PartNet-Mobility, Artic-O achieves strong reconstruction quality while being substantially more efficient than LARM, a strong prior method. It reduces Chamfer Distance, improves F-score, and achieves comparable or better articulation accuracy across most joint metrics, while reducing inference time from 9 minutes to about 0.3 seconds per object.
keywords: Computer Vision;3D Reconstruction;Animation / Motion;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Xuyang Wang, Zhenyu Li, Jian Ding, Habib Slim, Peter Wonka, Hongdong Li, Mohamed Elhoseiny

title: ABACUS：改造统一基础模型以打通图像计数理解与生成
title_en: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
abstract: 我们提出 ABACUS——一个统一的视觉语言模型，在单个 30 亿参数模型中同时处理目标计数、人群计数、指代表达式计数以及计数忠实的图像生成。ABACUS 有三项贡献：一是密度感知的自适应缩放，配合由多头自注意力分解得到的物体性图（objectness map）对计数预测进行空间定位；二是边界感知的计数策略，用嵌套的局部、边界与全局奖励通过 GRPO 训练，以消除裁剪边界处的多计与漏计；三是循环一致的 GRPO 策略，由冻结的理解分支对生成的候选在计数偏差与美学质量上打分，从而在无需任何外部评判器或标注的情况下弥合理解与生成之间的协同鸿沟。ABACUS 在七个基准上取得当前最优结果，涵盖目标计数（FSC-147、CARPK）、人群计数（ShanghaiTech A/B）、指代表达式计数（REC-8K）、计数忠实生成（CoCoCount、T2I-CompBench、GenEval）与计数推理（CountQA），超过了任务专用专家模型与更大的通用模型。项目主页：https://mondalanindya.github.io/pages/ABACUS。
abstract_en: We present ABACUS, a unified vision-language model that jointly addresses object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation within a single 3B-parameter model. ABACUS introduces three contributions: density-aware adaptive zooming paired with an objectness map from multi-head self-attention decomposition to spatially ground count predictions; a boundary-aware count policy trained via GRPO with nested local, boundary, and global rewards to eliminate over- and undercounting at crop boundaries; and a cycle-consistent GRPO strategy in which the frozen understanding branch scores generated candidates on count-deviation and aesthetic quality, closing the understanding-generation synergy gap without any external critic or annotation. ABACUS achieves state-of-the-art results across seven benchmarks spanning object counting (FSC-147, CARPK), crowd counting (ShanghaiTech A/B), referring-expression counting (REC-8K), count-faithful generation (CoCoCount, T2I-CompBench, GenEval), and count reasoning (CountQA), surpassing both task-specific specialists and larger generalist models. Project page is at https://mondalanindya.github.io/pages/ABACUS.
keywords: Computer Vision;Image/Video Processing;Image Generation / Editing;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Anindya Mondal, Sauradip Nag, Anjan Dutta

title: EgoPlay：面向第一人称视频流的事件触发式视频编辑
title_en: EgoPlay: Event-Triggered Video Editing for Egocentric Streams
abstract: 我们提出 EgoPlay——一个面向第一人称（自我中心）视频流的事件触发式视频到视频编辑器，它通过在主要由 Ego4D 构建的事件条件数据上微调预训练的 V2V 扩散 Transformer 得到。给定一段单目视频与形如“当 X 发生时，执行 Y”的事件触发提示，EgoPlay 推断事件 X 是否发生以及何时发生，保留事件发生前的帧，并仅对事件后的延续部分施加编辑 Y。EgoPlay 不是把独立的事件检测器与编辑器级联，而是在单个端到端模型中联合学习事件识别、时间克制与像素级编辑，同时还能处理否定式与多事件提示。为支撑这一点，我们构建了包含 10.6 万条事件触发片段—提示对的大规模数据集，覆盖正触发、伪造触发的负样本与多事件提示。随后我们训练一个带事件触发监督的双向视频扩散编辑器，并导出一个因果变体用于逐块流式推理。我们还提出事件感知的评测协议，分别度量触发后的编辑质量、触发前的保持程度以及误触发的鲁棒性。在 Ego4D 基准上，EgoPlay 大幅超越基于指令的第一人称视频编辑当前最优基线 EgoEdit，在编辑质量、视觉质量与背景一致性上分别取得 17.7%、16.9% 与 16.4% 的相对提升；在同组指标上比 VLM 引导的检测器—编辑器基线分别高出 15.7%、14.5% 与 13.5%，同时 GPU 显存占用不到其一半。
abstract_en: We introduce EgoPlay, an event-triggered video-to-video editor for egocentric streams, obtained by fine-tuning a pretrained V2V diffusion transformer on event-conditioned data built primarily from Ego4D. Given a monocular video and an event-triggered prompt of the form "when X happens, do Y," EgoPlay infers whether and when event X occurs, preserves pre-event frames, and applies edit Y only to the post-event continuation. Rather than cascading a separate event detector with an editor, EgoPlay learns event recognition, temporal restraint, and pixel-level editing jointly in a single end-to-end model, while also handling negative and multi-event prompts. To support this, we construct a large-scale dataset of 106K event-triggered clip-prompt pairs spanning positive triggers, fabricated-trigger negatives, and multi-event prompts. We then train a bidirectional video diffusion editor with event-triggered supervision and derive a causal variant for chunk-by-chunk streamable inference. We further introduce an event-aware evaluation protocol that separately measures post-trigger editing quality, pre-trigger preservation, and false-trigger robustness. On the Ego4D benchmark, EgoPlay substantially outperforms EgoEdit, the state-of-the-art instruction-based egocentric video editing baseline, with relative gains of 17.7%, 16.9%, and 16.4% in editing quality, visual quality, and background consistency. It also surpasses a VLM-guided detector-editor baseline by 15.7%, 14.5%, and 13.5% on the same metrics, while using less than half the GPU memory.
keywords: Computer Vision;Artificial Intelligence;Diffusion Model;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Video Generation / Editing;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Jinjie Mai, Gordon Guocheng Qian, Willi Menapace, Arpit Sahni, Chaoyang Wang, Ashkan Mirzaei, Runjia Li, Sergey Tulyakov, Bernard Ghanem, Peter Wonka, Rameen Abdal

title: InfiniSplat：面向大基线单目新视角合成的隐式高斯解码
title_en: InfiniSplat: Implicit Gaussian Decoding for Large-Baseline Monocular View Synthesis
abstract: 单图前馈三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）旨在直接从一张输入图像生成可渲染的三维场景表示，从而避免多视角采集与逐场景优化的开销。然而现有方法常受限于像素对齐的表示——高斯由固定的图像网格位置预测得到。这类像素对齐的本元在邻近视角渲染上效果尚可，但它们与底层场景表面的耦合较弱，在大视角变化下难以保持连贯结构。我们提出 InfiniSplat，一个前馈单图 3DGS 框架，从像素对齐表示迈向表面对齐表示。InfiniSplat 构建该表示的方式是：先用几何引导采样依据深度诱导的局部表面结构放置二维支撑点，再用查询条件化的隐式解码器，从在这些支撑点上查询到的图像特征预测高斯属性。通过把支撑点位置扎根于几何、并把高斯预测与固定像素中心解耦，InfiniSplat 产生的高斯布局更好地贴合场景表面，并减少了由网格离散化造成的散乱本元。在多个跨数据集的新视角合成评测中，InfiniSplat 相比单图前馈基线取得当前最优性能，并展现出从 Hypersim 室内合成训练到复杂开放世界场景的零样本泛化能力。项目主页：https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat。
abstract_en: Single-image feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to directly generate a renderable 3D scene representation from one input image, avoiding the cost of multi-view capture and per-scene optimization. However, existing methods are often constrained by a pixel-aligned representation, where Gaussians are predicted from fixed image-grid locations. Such pixel-aligned primitives can produce promising nearby-view renderings, but they remain weakly coupled to underlying scene surfaces and struggle to preserve coherent structures under large viewpoint shifts. We present InfiniSplat, a feed-forward single-image 3DGS framework that moves from a pixel-aligned representation toward a surface-aligned representation. InfiniSplat constructs this representation by first using geometry-guided sampling to place 2D supports according to depth-induced local surface structure, and then applying a query-conditioned implicit decoder to predict Gaussian attributes from the image features queried at these supports. By grounding support locations in geometry while decoupling Gaussian prediction from fixed pixel centers, InfiniSplat produces Gaussian layouts that better follow scene surfaces and reduce scattered primitives caused by grid discretization. Across multiple cross-dataset NVS evaluations, InfiniSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with single-image feed-forward baselines, and demonstrates zero-shot generalization from Hypersim indoor synthetic training to complex open-world scenes. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat.
keywords: Computer Vision;Gaussian Splatting;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Jiawei Wang, Hao Yu, Yongzhen Hu, Xinyi Yang, Tao Ni, Xin Zhan, Junbo Chen, Xiaowei Zhou, Ruizhen Hu, Sida Peng

title: SketchFlow：CLIP 隐空间中基于高斯混合先验流的零样本矢量草图生成
title_en: SketchFlow: Zero-Shot Vector Sketch Generation via GMM Prior Flow in CLIP Latent Space
abstract: 矢量草图仍是人类抽象表达中最简洁、最直接的媒介之一。然而由于细粒度、高质量的文本—草图配对数据严重稀缺，生成具有人类绘画风格的高质量矢量笔画仍是一个开放难题。现有的文本条件生成方法往往依赖不稳定且耗时的优化，或难以以零样本方式泛化到未见类别。为克服这些局限，我们提出 SketchFlow，一个根植于最优传输（OT）理论与流匹配的新型生成框架。借助预训练 CLIP 模型绕开繁重的图像级文本标注，我们直接在 CLIP 隐空间内把跨模态对齐表述为连续映射问题。为弥合离散文本概念与连续草图特征之间不可避免的模态鸿沟，我们首先向离散类别嵌入注入噪声，构造连续的高斯混合模型（GMM）先验；随后用最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）模型学习从该连续 GMM 先验到目标草图特征分布的确定性向量场映射。最后，我们设计了一个融合一维 U-Net 与 Transformer 架构的混合扩散解码器，把这些特征解码为快速且高保真的笔画轨迹。大量实验表明，SketchFlow 在视觉质量与对人类自然绘画风格的贴合度上大幅优于现有基线。此外，我们的保几何框架在超出 QuickDraw 训练词表的提示（包括未见概念标签与语义修饰词）上展现出有前景的局部零样本合成能力，并支持不同概念之间平滑连续的语义插值。源码见：https://github.com/doudin404/SketchFlow。
abstract_en: Vector sketches remain one of the most concise and immediate mediums for abstract human expression. However, generating high-quality vector strokes that exhibit human-like drawing styles remains an open challenge due to the severe scarcity of fine-grained, high-quality text-to-sketch paired data. Existing text-conditioned generation methods often rely on unstable, time-consuming optimization or struggle to generalize to unseen categories in a zero-shot manner. To address these limitations, we present SketchFlow, a novel generative framework rooted in Optimal Transport (OT) theory and flow matching. By leveraging pre-trained CLIP models to bypass labor-intensive image-level text annotations, we formulate cross-modal alignment as a continuous mapping problem directly within the CLIP latent space. To bridge the inevitable modality gap between discrete text concepts and continuous sketch features, we first inject noise into discrete category embeddings to construct a continuous Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) prior. We then utilize an Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) model to learn a deterministic vector field mapping from this continuous GMM prior to the target sketch feature distribution. Finally, a Hybrid Diffusion Decoder, fusing 1D U-Net and Transformer architectures, is designed to decode these features into fast and high-fidelity stroke trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SketchFlow substantially outperforms existing baselines in visual quality and adherence to natural human drawing styles. Furthermore, our geometry-preserving framework demonstrates promising local zero-shot synthesis for prompts beyond the QuickDraw training vocabulary, including unseen concept labels and semantic modifiers, while enabling smooth, continuous semantic interpolation between distinct concepts. Source code is available at: https://github.com/doudin404/SketchFlow.
keywords: Computer Vision;Diffusion Model;Avatar / Human
authors: Jin Zhou, Hongliang Yang, Pengfei Xu, Hui Huang

title: 非线性波浪与三维流体的哈密顿双向耦合
title_en: Hamiltonian Two-Way Coupling of Nonlinear Waves and 3D Flows
abstract: 把一个局部的三维流体求解器与一个更廉价的二维表面模型相耦合来模拟大规模自由表面水体，长期面临波浪动力学不匹配的问题：图形学中常用的高效二维波浪模型通常是线性的或非色散的。这类模型快速、简单，对平静的小幅海面也足够准确，但把它们与强非线性的三维求解器耦合时，会在二维—三维交界处产生可见的反射与伪影。我们通过引入一个基于经典 Zakharov 表述的非线性、色散二维波浪模型来解决这个问题。该模型的哈密顿结构——表面高程与表面势构成一对由波浪能驱动的正则变量 (η, ψ)——使得可以设计一种正则一致的（canonically consistent）双向耦合方案，让信息在二维—三维交界处平滑传递。我们的二维求解器相比 SWE、BEM 与 Airy 基线把平均波高误差降低 1.7–5 倍，同时比 BEM 快 10³ 倍以上；相比 SWE 与 Airy，它取得更高的非线性精度与耦合保真度，仅在速度与稳定性上有轻微损失。将其与三维 Navier–Stokes 求解器耦合后，所得完整系统在色散匹配与 Kelvin 尾迹等一系列实验中抑制了可见的接缝伪影，并在同一计算域上比纯 GPU 的 NB-FLIP 仿真快 4 倍以上。
abstract_en: Simulating large-scale free-surface water by coupling a localized 3D fluid solver to a cheaper 2D surface model has long faced a mismatch in wave dynamics: efficient 2D wave models used in graphics are typically either linear or non-dispersive. These models are fast, simple, and accurate for calm, small-amplitude seas, but coupling them with strongly nonlinear 3D solvers produces visible reflections and artifacts at the 2D--3D interface. We address this problem by introducing a nonlinear and dispersive 2D wave model based on the canonical Zakharov formulation. Its Hamiltonian structure, in which the surface elevation and surface potential form a canonical pair ($η$, $ψ$) governed by the wave energy, enables a canonically consistent two-way coupling scheme, allowing information to pass smoothly across the 2D--3D interface. Our 2D solver reduces mean wave-height error by 1.7--5$\times$ over SWE, BEM, and Airy baselines while running more than $10^3\times$ faster than BEM; it achieves greater nonlinear accuracy and coupling fidelity than SWE and Airy, with minor losses in speed and stability. Coupling it with a 3D Navier--Stokes solver yields a full system that suppresses visible seam artifacts across a range of experiments, including dispersion-matching and Kelvin-wake tests, and runs over 4$\times$ faster than a pure GPU NB-FLIP simulation on the same domain.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Numerical Analysis;Avatar / Human;Physics Simulation;Geometry Processing
authors: Sinan Wang, Ruicheng Wang, Taiyuan Zhang, Fan Feng, Jinjin He, Yuchen Sun, Zhiqi Li, Bo Zhu

title: 通过诊断引导的候选回收实现视频扩散模型的测试时扩展
title_en: Test-Time Scaling for Video Diffusion Models via Diagnosis-Guided Candidate Recycling
abstract: 近期视频扩散模型已取得令人瞩目的生成质量，但高保真结果仍很大程度上依赖闭源系统或昂贵的大规模基础设施。测试时扩展（TTS）提供了一种免训练的方式：通过投入额外的推理算力来提升轻量生成器，然而现有方法大多仍停留在噪声搜索范式内——它们采样、选择或扰动去噪轨迹，并在昂贵的生成之后丢弃低分候选。这种“生成即丢弃”的过程不仅浪费算力，也浪费了可恢复样本中已经编码的部分运动、布局或外观结构。我们提出 GEARS（Guided Editing for Adaptive Recycling Search，自适应回收搜索的引导式编辑），一个免训练框架，把“诊断引导的候选回收”引入视频 TTS：通过“生成—评估—编辑”的循环，把这类候选转化为可编辑的先验。GEARS 由两个协同组件构成。阶段感知调度器决定修复什么、何时修复，以及哪些候选应被保留、回收或丢弃。候选回收器从关键帧与多维奖励反馈中诊断出可恢复的失败，推导针对具体候选的修复提示，并通过流形感知的潜空间 SDEdit 修复相应候选。修复后的候选被回收进搜索池，从而在标准噪声扰动之外开辟精化路径，同时保留有用的结构。在相同的 NFE 预算下，GEARS 在 VBench 上一致优于现有视频 TTS 方法，把 1.3B 模型的总分提升到与 14B 模型相当的水平；消融实验验证了自适应调度、诊断条件化编辑以及流形感知重去噪的必要性。代码已在 GitHub 发布。
abstract_en: Recent video diffusion models have achieved remarkable generation quality, but high-fidelity results still largely depend on closed-source systems or costly large-scale infrastructure. Test-time scaling (TTS) offers a training-free way to improve lightweight generators by spending additional inference compute, yet existing methods mostly remain within a noise-search paradigm: they sample, select, or perturb denoising trajectories and discard low-scoring candidates after expensive generation. This generate-and-discard process wastes not only computation but also the partial motion, layout, or appearance structure already encoded in recoverable samples. We present \textbf{GEARS} (\textbf{G}uided \textbf{E}diting for \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}ecycling \textbf{S}earch), a training-free framework that introduces {diagnosis-guided candidate recycling} into video TTS by turning such candidates into editable priors through a generation-evaluation-editing loop. GEARS consists of two collaborative components. The \textbf{Stage-Aware Scheduler} determines what to repair, when to repair it, and which candidates should be preserved, recycled, or discarded. The \textbf{Candidate Recycler} diagnoses recoverable failures from keyframes and multi-dimensional reward feedback, derives candidate-specific repair prompts, and repairs the corresponding candidates through manifold-aware latent SDEdit. The repaired candidates are recycled into the search pool, creating refinement paths beyond standard noise perturbation while preserving useful structure. Under matched NFE budgets, GEARS consistently outperforms existing video TTS methods on VBench, bringing a 1.3B model to a total score comparable to a 14B counterpart, and ablations verify the necessity of adaptive scheduling, diagnosis-conditioned editing, and manifold-aware re-denoising. Code is available on GitHub.
keywords: Computer Vision;Diffusion Model;Animation / Motion;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Hangzhou He, Lunhao Duan, Shanshan Zhao, Kaiwen Li, Qing-Guo Chen, Weihua Luo, Yanye Lu

title: 面向笼架变形的域变化二维格林函数
title_en: Domain-Varying 2D Green' s Functions for Cage-based Deformation
abstract: 本文基于域变化格林函数，提出一种关于笼架变形的新理论视角，并把该“域”视为调控变形效果的新控制空间。调和坐标（HC）与格林坐标（GC）是笼架变形中的经典方法，也是众多实用变形工具中形状编辑的理论基础。我们的方法重新审视了这两种经典方法。具体而言，我们提出一个基于跨不同域（独立于笼架所围成的域）的格林函数的框架，把这两种技术统一起来。据我们所知，这是近二十年来首次此类尝试。基于这一视角，我们提出一种新的笼架变形技术：它引入新的控制空间，并利用域变化格林函数产生不同的变形效果。当格林函数的域 Θ 从笼架区域 Ω 扩展到整个 R² 时，本方法还建立了从 HC 到 GC 的效果连续过渡。我们把该方法称为域变化格林坐标（DVGC）。当 Θ 为圆盘或矩形时，格林函数分别具有解析或半解析表达，使 DVGC 无需有限元离散即可计算。此外，当 Θ 为圆盘时，DVGC 对二维单纯形笼架具有闭式表达，从而免去数值积分。实验表明，本方法提供了一个从“更贴合笼架”到“更保形”的新控制空间，通过改变格林函数域即可产生多样的变形效果。
abstract_en: In this work, we propose a novel theoretical view of cage-based deformation based on domain-varying Green' s functions and treat this domain as a new control space for the deformation effects. Harmonic Coordinates (HC) and Green Coordinates (GC) are classic methods in cage-based deformation and serve as the theoretical foundation for shape editing in a range of practical deformation tools. Our method revisits these two classical approaches. Specifically, we propose a framework based on Green' s functions across diverse domains (independent of the cage-enclosed domain) to unify these two techniques. To our knowledge, this represents the first such attempt in nearly two decades. Based on this perspective, we propose a novel cage-based deformation technique that introduces a new control space and utilizes domain-varying Green' s functions to yield varying deformation effects. Our method also establishes a continuous transition of effects from HC to GC as the Green' s function domain $Θ$ expands from the cage region $Ω$ to the entire $\mathbb{R}^2$. We call our method Domain-Varying Green Coordinates (DVGC). When $Θ$ is a disk or a rectangle, the Green' s function possesses analytic or semi-analytic expressions, respectively, enabling the DVGC to be computed without finite element discretization. Furthermore, when $Θ$ is a disk, the DVGC admit a closed-form expression for 2D simplicial cages, thereby eliminating the need for numerical integration. Experiments demonstrate that our method provides a novel control space ranging from more consistent with the cage to more shape-preserving, generating diverse deformation effects by varying the Green' s function domains.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Geometry Processing
authors: Dong Xiao, Renjie Chen, Bailin Deng

title: FoldingAgent：从演示视频推断参数化折纸流程
title_en: FoldingAgent: Inferring Parametric Origami Procedures from Demonstration Videos
abstract: 我们提出 FoldingAgent，一个可直接从折纸演示视频推断显式参数化折叠程序的智能体框架。该框架利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力，并为其配备一套专门工具，使智能体能够模拟几何变换、验证物理合理性、检索与比较视觉内容，并对自身预测进行评估。为把视觉内容转化为折叠程序，我们定义了一个参数空间，由纸张几何与一组参数化折叠动作构成。与预测静态折痕图案的模型不同，我们的智能体按序操作，并具备重新规划动作的能力，从而有效缓解多步折叠中固有的误差累积。人类折纸知识主要通过非结构化的视觉演示传播，而计算方法通常依赖折痕图案或可执行参数化方案这类结构化、参数化表示；本工作朝着弥合二者之间的鸿沟迈出了一步。我们在 PurelandFold 上评估该方法——这是一个新构建的基准，包含多样的纯地折纸（Pureland origami）视频及其真值几何与动作标注。结果表明，通过把 VLM 推理与一套专门工具及物理仿真相结合，我们能够成功地把非结构化的视觉演示转化为可执行、物理合理的折叠流程。
abstract_en: We present FoldingAgent, an agentic framework for inferring explicit parametric folding programs directly from origami demonstration videos. Our framework leverages the reasoning power of a pre-trained Vision-Language Model (VLM) equipped with a suite of specialized tools that enable the agent to simulate geometric transitions, verify physical plausibility, retrieve and compare visual content, and evaluate its own predictions. To translate visual content into folding programs, we define a parametric space that consists of the paper's geometry and a set of parametric folding actions. Unlike models that predict static crease patterns, our agent operates sequentially and possesses the ability to re-plan its actions, effectively mitigating the compounding errors inherent in multi-step folding. Our approach takes a step toward closing the gap between human origami knowledge, which is primarily shared through unstructured visual demonstrations, and computational methods, which typically rely on structured, parametric representations such as a crease pattern or an executable parametric plan. We evaluate our approach on PurelandFold, a newly curated benchmark of diverse Pureland origami videos with ground-truth geometry and action labels. Our results demonstrate that by combining VLM reasoning with a set of specialized tools and physical simulation, we can successfully transform unstructured visual demonstrations into executable, physically plausible folding procedures.
keywords: Computer Vision;Artificial Intelligence;Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Physics Simulation;CAD / Modeling;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Maya Moriya, Sigal Raab, Yael Vinker, Tali Dekel

title: 以线段本元建模的逆渲染
title_en: Inverse Rendering for Modeling with Line Primitives
abstract: 要忠实地重建真实世界中具有模糊、各向异性结构的多样物体（如毛发、绒毛、纤维与织物）以用于高效实时可视化，仍具挑战。近来的辐射场重建方法用三维高斯这类半透明体本元从多视角图像中捕捉这些结构，而不再使用不透明低维本元（如三角形、线段与折线），这限制了对标准深度测试光栅化、反射建模与物理仿真的兼容性。我们提出一种逆渲染方法，用显式线段重建模糊几何：线段在亚像素网格上光栅化以实现抗锯齿，从而再现半透明外观。虽然渲染直截了当，但要让大量线段本元优化到匹配目标图像却是一大挑战。为此我们引入一种针对线段的随机可微光栅化器，它能就顶点位置、属性与离散连通性产生有信息量的梯度。在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，本方法在捕捉模糊边界上优于基于表面的方法，并在完全依赖显式几何的前提下达到与体表示相当的质量。所得表示可与标准图形管线无缝集成，从而支持跨平台渲染、多种着色模型与物理仿真。
abstract_en: Faithfully capturing diverse real-world objects with fuzzy, anisotropic structures, such as hair, fur, fibers, and textiles, for efficient real-time visualization remains challenging. Recent radiance field reconstruction methods capture these structures from multi-view images using translucent volumetric primitives such as 3D Gaussians rather than opaque low-dimensional primitives (e.g., triangles, line segments, and polylines), thereby limiting compatibility with standard depth-tested rasterization, reflection modeling, and physical simulation. We present an inverse rendering method for reconstructing fuzzy geometry using explicit line segments, which are rasterized on a subpixel grid for anti-aliasing to reproduce a semi-transparent appearance. While straightforward to render, optimizing numerous line primitives to match target images poses a significant challenge. We address this by introducing a stochastic differentiable rasterizer for line segments that produces informative gradients with respect to vertex positions, attributes, and discrete connectivity. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that our method outperforms surface-based approaches in capturing fuzzy boundaries and achieves quality comparable to volumetric representations while relying entirely on explicit geometry. The resulting representation integrates seamlessly with standard graphics pipelines, enabling cross-platform rendering, various shading models, and physical simulation.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;Inverse Rendering;NeRF / Radiance Field;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Physics Simulation;Geometry Processing
authors: Kenji Tojo, Ariel Shamir, Nobuyuki Umetani, Bernd Bickel

title: 重参数化三维高斯泼溅以实现实时基于调色板的颜色与亮度编辑
title_en: Reparametrizing 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Palette-based Color and Luminance Editing
abstract: 专业调色既需要精确控制颜色（色相与饱和度），也需要精确控制亮度，理想情况下由彼此独立的控制器完成。我们提出一个面向三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的实时交互式颜色编辑框架，支持基于调色板的重新着色、逐调色板的色调曲线（用于颜色感知的亮度调节）以及像素级颜色约束。我们不从零训练新的表示，而是对预训练的原始 3DGS 的球谐系数进行重参数化，使其编码视角相关的调色板权重；并同时求解权重与调色板颜色，损失基于图像空间的稀疏性。亮度编辑实现为沿非彩色轴的逐像素权重偏移，我们证明它等价于逐像素的调色板感知亮度编辑。这种视角空间表述解决了先前本元空间方法的核心局限：alpha 混合破坏了逐高斯的稀疏性，导致编辑渗入非预期区域。借助迭代重加权最小二乘与阻尼块坐标下降，在视角空间稀疏性下把色调曲线与调色板偏移耦合求解，我们的编辑可在数十毫秒内完成。所得表示可高效烘焙回原始 3DGS，保持与标准查看器的兼容性。我们展示了比先前基于调色板的 3DGS 方法更稀疏、更局部的编辑，同时实现了逐调色板颜色的独立亮度控制与视角一致的像素级约束——这些能力此前在 3DGS 上尚不具备。
abstract_en: Professional color editing requires precise control over both color (hue and saturation) and lightness, ideally through separate, independent controls. We present a real-time interactive color editing framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that supports palette-based recoloring, per-palette tone curves for color-aware luminance adjustment, and pixel-level color constraints. Rather than training a new representation from scratch, we reparameterize the spherical harmonics of a pretrained vanilla 3DGS to encode view-dependent palette weights. We simultaneously solve for weights and palette colors via a loss based on image-space sparsity. Luminance editing is realized as a per-pixel weight shift along the achromatic axis, which we show is equivalent to a per-pixel palette-aware luminance edit. This view-space formulation addresses a core limitation of prior primitive-space methods, where alpha-blending breaks per-Gaussian sparsity and causes edits to bleed into unintended regions. Our edits run in tens of milliseconds via an iteratively reweighted least squares and damped block-coordinate descent that couples tone curves and palette shifts under view-space sparsity. Our representation can be efficiently baked back into a vanilla 3DGS, preserving compatibility with standard viewers. We demonstrate sparser, more localized edits than prior palette-based 3DGS methods, while enabling independent luminance control per palette color and view-consistent pixel-level constraints, capabilities previously unavailable for 3DGS.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Gaussian Splatting
authors: Cheng-Kang Ted Chao, Yotam Gingold

title: 通过伪影驱动的运动学先验精化实现蒙皮动作重定向
title_en: Skinned Motion Retargeting via Artifact-driven Kinematic Prior Refinement
abstract: 动作重定向旨在把源动作迁移到具有不同骨骼结构、比例与体型的目标角色上。尽管近来的神经重定向方法提升了对多样骨架的灵活性，目标侧的几何伪影（如自穿插）仍难以解决。具体而言，现有几何感知方法往往依赖固定的骨架模板或隐式的几何条件预测，要求单个网络仅凭目标几何就同时考虑目标几何变形、检测目标侧伪影并预测相应修正，这限制了它们跨多样骨骼结构与体型的泛化能力。本文提出一个几何感知的动作重定向框架，它把在摆姿后角色几何上观测到的伪影与动作精化显式联系起来，同时保留与骨架无关的神经重定向的灵活性。本方法首先用一个基于 Transformer 的重定向自编码器学习跨不同骨架共享的动作嵌入，该编码器可在任意源—目标骨架对之间迁移动作。在这一运动学动作先验之上，我们引入伪影驱动的精化模块：它观测摆姿后目标网格上的自穿插，并通过动作到顶点的雅可比将其转化为修正线索。我们进一步用由静置姿态网格导出的、基于蒙皮权重的关节对齐几何特征，把动作解码条件化于目标几何。该设计在统一框架中把显式的目标侧伪影推理与灵活的几何感知解码结合起来。在固定骨架结构与任意骨架结构两种设定下的实验表明，本方法提升了运动学重定向精度并减少了几何伪影，在见过与未见过目标角色上都能产生合理的动作。
abstract_en: Motion retargeting aims to transfer a source motion to target characters with different skeletal structures, proportions, and body shapes. Although recent neural retargeting methods have improved flexibility across diverse skeletons, target-side geometric artifacts such as self-penetration remain difficult to resolve. Specifically, existing geometry-aware approaches often rely on fixed skeleton templates or implicit geometry-conditioned prediction, requiring a single network to account for target geometry deformation, detect target-side artifacts, and predict the corresponding correction from target geometry alone, which limits their ability to generalize across diverse skeleton structures and body shapes. In this paper, we present a geometry-aware motion retargeting framework that explicitly connects artifacts observed in the posed character geometry to motion refinement while preserving the flexibility of skeleton-agnostic neural retargeting. Our method first learns a motion embedding shared across different skeletons using a transformer-based retargeting autoencoder that transfers motion across arbitrary source--target skeleton pairs. Building on this kinematic motion prior, we introduce an artifact-driven refinement module that observes self-penetration on the posed target mesh and converts it into a corrective cue through a motion-to-vertex Jacobian. We further condition motion decoding on target geometry using skinning weight-based joint-aligned geometry features derived from the rest pose mesh. This design combines explicit target-side artifact reasoning with flexible geometry-aware decoding in a unified framework. Experiments on both fixed and arbitrary skeleton structure settings show that our method improves kinematic retargeting accuracy and reduces geometric artifacts, producing plausible motions across seen and unseen target characters.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Geometry Processing;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Seokhyeon Hong, Chaelin Kim, Inseo Jang, Soojin Choi, Junyong Noh

title: 以上下文条件化交互先验统一基于物理的人形交互
title_en: Unifying Physics-Based Humanoid Interaction with a Context-Conditioned Interaction Prior
abstract: 开发能够穿行复杂三维场景并操控物体的统一物理人形控制器，一直是一项长期挑战。现有方法往往专门针对移动或针对以物体为中心的操控，或依赖难以跨多样行为扩展的任务专用奖励工程。我们提出 CHIP，一个统一的、扎根于物理的框架，可从异构动作数据中学习可复用的人形交互技能。本方法的核心是一个条件交互先验，它在共享的离散空间内对这些技能建模出一个依赖上下文的分布。方法分三阶段训练。首先学习基于物理的动作模仿策略，从异构交互数据中获得扎根的教师行为。随后把这些行为蒸馏进一个上下文条件化的交互先验，以捕捉跨移动与操控可复用的动作结构。最后，从预训练先验初始化下游任务策略，并通过先验正则化的在线强化学习后训练对其适配。在多样的人形交互任务套件上的实验表明，本方法支持场景感知的移动、富接触的物体操控，以及诸如环境感知的物体搬运与长时程技能序列等组合行为，同时产生平滑过渡与物理合理的动作。
abstract_en: Developing unified physics-based humanoid controllers that can navigate complex 3D scenes and manipulate objects remains a longstanding challenge. Existing approaches are often specialized for either locomotion or object-centric manipulation, or rely on task-specific reward engineering that does not scale well across diverse behaviors. We present CHIP, a unified, physics-grounded framework for learning reusable humanoid interaction skills from heterogeneous motion data. Central to our approach is a conditional interaction prior that models a context-dependent distribution over these skills within a shared discrete space. Our method is trained in three stages. We first learn physics-based motion-imitation policies that acquire grounded teacher behaviors from heterogeneous interaction data. We then distill these behaviors into a context-conditioned interaction prior that captures reusable motion structure across locomotion and manipulation. Finally, we initialize downstream task policies from the pretrained prior and adapt them through prior-regularized online RL post-training. Experiments on a diverse suite of humanoid interaction tasks show that our approach supports scene-aware locomotion, contact-rich object manipulation, and compositional behaviors such as environment-aware object transport and long-horizon skill sequencing, while producing smooth transitions and physically plausible motion.
keywords: Robotics;Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Physics Simulation
authors: Jianan Li, Xiao Chen, Tien-Tsin Wong

title: ADELE——面向高保真网格原生重建的自适应 Delaunay 网格
title_en: ADELE - Adaptive Delaunay Grids for High-Fidelity Mesh-Native Reconstruction
abstract: 网格仍是几何推理与图形管线集成中最实用的表示，但现有重建方法难以产出高质量网格。多数最先进方法先学习一种中间表示（NeRF/3DGS），再把网格提取当作后处理步骤，这往往导致表面过度平滑，或产生三角面数过多的低质量网格。现有的网格原生优化方法缓解了其中部分问题，但受制于固定分辨率的离散化与不稳定的优化行为。本文提出一个自适应网格优化框架与一种实用的网格渲染技术来应对这些挑战。我们的表示把可优化的 Delaunay 三角化四面体网格与多分辨率哈希网格相结合：前者通过点的剪枝与插入进行细化，后者为 SDF/外观值预测提供潜在特征。我们用体渲染来启动粗几何，同时借助基于网格的渲染恢复细粒度细节。此外，我们提出一种可微的、基于光栅化的深度偏移渲染表述，减少几何伪影并提升重建质量。本方法在多种以物体为中心的基准上显著优于现有网格优化方法，并与最先进的 NeRF/3DGS 方法具有竞争力。
abstract_en: Meshes remain the most practical representation for geometry reasoning and integration into graphics pipelines, yet existing reconstruction methods struggle to produce high-quality meshes. Most state-of-the-art approaches initially learn an intermediate representation (NeRF/3DGS) and treat mesh extraction as a post-processing step, which often leads to oversmoothed surfaces or poor quality meshes with excessive triangle counts.Existing mesh-native optimization methods alleviate some of these issues but suffer from fixed-resolution discretizations and unstable optimization behavior. In this paper, we introduce an adaptive mesh-based optimization framework and a practical mesh rendering technique to address these challenges. Our representation combines an optimizable Delaunay-triangulated tetrahedral grid with a multi-resolution hash grid. The former is refined through point pruning and insertion, while the latter provides latent features for SDF/appearance value predictions. We use volumetric rendering to bootstrap a coarse geometry while leveraging mesh-based rendering for recovering fine-grained details. Additionally, we propose a differentiable, rasterization-based depth-offset rendering formulation, reducing geometric artifacts and improving reconstruction quality. Our method significantly outperforms existing mesh optimization approaches across a variety of object-centric benchmarks while being competitive with state-of-the-art NeRF/3DGS methods.
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Gaussian Splatting;NeRF / Radiance Field;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Johannes Weidenfeller, Shaofei Wang, Philipp Fürnstahl, Siyu Tang

title: InstantMimic：秒级学习基于物理技能的高性能系统
title_en: InstantMimic: A High Performance System for Learning Physics-based Skills in Seconds
abstract: 基于物理的角色控制是计算机图形学与机器人学中的长期挑战，需要策略在满足复杂动力学的同时产生真实动作。近来的深度强化学习方法——尤其是 DeepMimic 等模仿学习方法——影响已远超动画领域，通过实现敏捷且富有表现力的行为而影响了机器人学。这些方法虽取得令人印象深刻的成果，但在实践中训练仍然算力效率低下。尽管有 GPU 加速仿真，我们发现端到端流程常常未充分利用硬件，原因在于物理求解器之外的额外开销——关键路径上碎片化的 GPU 核函数与 CPU 内存访问。我们提出 InstantMimic，一个通过让整个训练循环 GPU 原生化来解决这些低效问题的系统。它构建在 GPU 原生的物理后端之上，统一流程把仿真、环境计算、策略推理与策略更新集成到单一执行流中。由此，InstantMimic 把多种基于物理的技能训练时间缩短到数秒，并使由 LLM 智能体驱动的超参数搜索变得可行。
abstract_en: Physics-based character control is a long-standing challenge in computer graphics and robotics, requiring policies that satisfy complex dynamics while producing realistic motion. Recent Deep RL approaches, particularly imitation learning methods such as DeepMimic, have had broad impact beyond animation, influencing robotics by enabling agile and expressive behaviors. While these approaches achieve impressive results, they remain computationally inefficient to train in practice. Despite GPU-accelerated simulation, we find that end-to-end pipelines often underutilize hardware due to overheads outside the physics solver, caused by fragmented GPU kernels and CPU memory access in the critical path. We present InstantMimic, a system that addresses these inefficiencies by making the entire training loop GPU-native. Built on a GPU-native physics backend, our unified pipeline integrates simulation, environment computation, policy inference, and policy updates within a single execution flow. As a result, InstantMimic reduces training time for diverse physics-based skills to a few seconds and makes LLM-agent-driven hyperparameter search practical.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Robotics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Physics Simulation
authors: Ikjun Choi, Geonho Leem, Jungdam Won

title: 投下光照：评估生成式图像模型光照理解能力的基准
title_en: Shedding Light: A Benchmark for Evaluating Lighting Understanding in Generative Image Models
abstract: 准确建模光照是真实感图像合成与场景理解的核心。然而，关于图像生成模型是否擅长这一任务、物理合理性是否仍是其关键挑战，目前探索甚少。显然，真实感图像合成已取得显著进展，但模型是否以物理准确的方式真正理解光照？为回答这一问题，本文提出一个基准，用于评估生成模型的光照理解与协调能力。我们的关键洞见是：评估这类模型的光照理解，只需检验它们把新物体插入真实照片时能否保持光照一致。为此，我们使用一个多光照数据集，其中图像包含作为“光照探针”的简单物体；提示模型把同一物体修复（inpaint）到原图上，再把生成结果与真值光照探针比较。随后我们从修复后的探针中估计光照方向、颜色与辐照度分布，从而给出光照准确性与光度真实感的定量度量。本工作建立了一套可扩展的评测协议，用以系统评估生成模型捕捉与再现真实世界光照的能力，为衡量任何未来模型的光度准确性提供了基础。全部代码与数据见 https://lvsn.github.io/SheddingLight/ 。
abstract_en: Accurate modelling of illumination is central to realistic image synthesis and scene understanding. Yet, there is little exploration into whether image generative models are good at this task or whether physical plausibility remains a key challenge for them. Clearly, significant progress has been made in realistic image synthesis, but do models truly understand lighting in a physically accurate manner? To answer this question, this work proposes a benchmark to assess the lighting understanding and harmonisation capabilities of generative models. Our key insight is that evaluating lighting understanding for such models only requires testing how well they insert novel objects into real photographs whilst maintaining consistent illumination. To do so, we use a multi-illumination dataset with images containing simple objects serving as ``light probes'', and prompt models to inpaint the same object onto the original image, then compare the generated results against the ground-truth light probes. We then estimate the lighting direction, colour and radiance distribution from the inpainted probes, providing a quantitative measure of illumination accuracy and photometric realism. Our work establishes a scalable evaluation protocol to systematically assess how well generative models capture and reproduce real-world lighting, offering a foundation for benchmarking the photometric accuracy of any future models. All code and data are available at https://lvsn.github.io/SheddingLight/ .
keywords: Computer Vision;Lighting / Illumination;Image Generation / Editing;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Justine Giroux, Jack Oliver Hilliard, Yannick Hold-Geoffroy, Javier Vazquez-Corral, Jean-François Lalonde

title: ReCHOIR：面向多样角色的接触引导人—物交互重定向
title_en: ReCHOIR: Contact-guided Human Object Interaction Retargeting to Diverse Characters
abstract: 我们提出 ReCHOIR，一种新的接触引导动作重定向方法，用于把人物—物体交互（HOI）动作迁移到多样的人形角色上。与主要关注单独迁移人体动作的既有重定向方法不同，我们的目标是不只保留原始身体运动的语义，还保留角色与被操控物体之间一致的交互，并同时产出对齐的目标人体与物体动作。给定源 HOI 动作、物体几何以及从源交互中提取的接触线索，ReCHOIR 把 HOI 序列重定向到具有不同骨骼配置的目标角色，同时保持动作语义与接触一致的交互模式。本方法建立在一个部位感知动作嵌入（PAME）自编码器之上，它把全身动作编码进共享的、按身体部位划分的隐空间。该表示使方法能跨异构骨架泛化，同时保留有利于 HOI 重定向中部位感知适配的局部动作语义。在此表示之上，我们为 HOI 重定向引入一个接触引导重定向模块和一个物体动作解码器。接触引导重定向模块把源物体交互视为精化目标角色动作的条件：与物体和接触相关的信号被编码为身体部位对齐的隐表示，并通过残差控制分支注入解码过程，从而在交互相关的身体区域实现更强的适配，同时不丢弃底层的动作先验。与此同时，物体动作解码器预测与精化后的目标角色动作对齐的目标物体动作，确保物体轨迹与目标角色实际实现交互的方式保持一致。
abstract_en: We present ReCHOIR, a novel contact-guided motion retargeting method for transferring human object interaction (HOI) motions across diverse humanoid characters. Unlike prior motion retargeting methods that primarily focus on transferring human motion alone, our goal is to preserve not only the semantics of the original body movement but also consistent interaction between the character and the manipulated object, while jointly producing aligned target human and object motions. Given source HOI motion, object geometry, and contact cues extracted from the source interaction, ReCHOIR retargets an HOI sequence to target characters with different skeletal configurations while maintaining both motion semantics and contact-consistent interaction patterns. Our method builds on a Part-Aware Motion Embedding (PAME) autoencoder, which encodes full-body motion into a shared body-part-wise latent space. This representation enables generalization across heterogeneous skeletons while preserving local motion semantics beneficial for part-aware adaptation in HOI retargeting. On top of this representation, we introduce a contact-guided retargeting module and an object motion decoder for HOI retargeting. The contact-guided retargeting module treats the source object interaction as a condition for refining target character motion: object- and contact-related signals are encoded into a body-part-aligned latent representation and injected into decoding through a residual control branch, enabling stronger adaptation in interaction-relevant body regions without discarding the underlying motion prior. In parallel, the object motion decoder predicts a target object motion aligned with the refined target character motion, ensuring that the object trajectory remains consistent with how the interaction is realized by the target character.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Physics Simulation
authors: Chaelin Kim, Seokhyeon Hong, Kwan Yun, Soojin Choi, Inseo Jang, Junyong Noh

title: 高斯光传输
title_en: Gaussian Light Transport
abstract: 我们提出一种计算全局光照的新方法：把光传输方程的解表示为位置、方向、表面法线与材质属性上的 13 维高斯混合模型。我们表明，把场景属性纳入高斯表示可大幅减少所需函数的数量并加速求值。与基于诺伊曼级数的传统光传输方法不同，本模型的参数直接通过最小化渲染方程的残差来估计。由于优化与渲染都需要反复求值高维高斯函数的线性组合，我们引入一种高效的剔除（culling）策略，使优化保持可解，并实现实时渲染。我们的表示能够快速渲染与视角无关的光传输方程解，渲染时间在毫秒量级，且内存需求仅为传统神经渲染方法的一小部分。
abstract_en: We present a novel method for computing global illumination by expressing the solution to the light transport equation as a 13D Gaussian mixture model over positions, directions, surface normals, and material properties. We show that including scene properties in the Gaussian representation drastically reduces the number of functions and speeds up evaluation. As opposed to traditional light transport methods based on Neumann series, the parameters of our model are directly estimated by minimizing the residual of the rendering equation. While both optimization and rendering require repeated evaluations of a linear combination of high-dimensional Gaussian functions, we introduce an efficient culling strategy to keep the optimization tractable and produce renderings in real time. Our representation enables to render fast, view-independent solutions to the light transport equation, achieving rendering times on the order of milliseconds, with a fraction of the memory requirements of conventional neural rendering approaches.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Lighting / Illumination;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Patrick Attimont, Kartic Subr, Cyril Soler

title: 级联非视域成像
title_en: Cascaded Non-Line-of-Sight Imaging
abstract: 飞行时间非视域（NLOS）成像通过分析在可见（中继）墙上散射的间接光子的飞行时间，来恢复隐藏物体的信息。多数方法作了一个简化假设：光子只走三次弹射路径，从而忽略了编码在高阶光子（例如四跳或五跳路径）中的其他有用信息。我们提出一种新的级联 NLOS 成像方法，利用高阶信息，可对更广泛的单拐角与多拐角场景成像。我们把超快激光扫描与近来的时间门控二维传感器阵列结合，在可见中继墙上采集场景的冲激响应。由采集到的冲激响应，本方法可计算出任意其他隐藏墙上的类似虚拟冲激响应。这实际上使我们能够接上一个利用高阶光照的第二个、虚拟的 NLOS 成像系统。我们在仿真与真实样机上验证了该级联成像方法，展示了对处于困难朝向、且隐藏在两个拐角之后的物体，用四跳与五跳光照实现 NLOS 成像。我们还分析了基于波的 NLOS 成像如何与粗糙隐藏墙相互作用，从而解释并帮助克服现有的可见性限制。我们进一步说明如何依靠多面隐藏墙，从不同视角对隐藏物体成像，从而观察到此前不可见的特征。
abstract_en: Time-of-flight non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging recovers information from hidden objects by analyzing the time of flight of indirect photons scattered on a visible (relay) wall. Most methods make the simplifying assumption that photons travel exclusively three-bounce paths, thus ignoring other useful information encoded in higher-order photons (with, e.g., four- or five-bounce paths). We present a novel cascaded NLOS imaging approach that leverages higher-order information and allows imaging a broader range of single- and multi-corner scenarios. We combine ultra-fast laser scanning with recent time-gated 2D sensor arrays to capture the scene's impulse response on a visible relay wall. From the captured impulse response, our method computes an analogous virtual impulse response at any other hidden wall. This effectively allows us to concatenate a second, virtual NLOS imaging system that leverages higher-order illumination. We validate our cascaded imaging method both in simulation and with a real prototype, demonstrating NLOS imaging with fourth- and fifth-bounce illumination of objects in challenging orientations and hidden around two corners. We also analyze how wave-based NLOS imaging interacts with rough hidden walls, which explains and helps overcome existing visibility limitations. We further illustrate how to image hidden objects from different perspectives, thus observing previously unseen features, by relying on multiple hidden walls.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;Lighting / Illumination;Physics Simulation;Image Generation / Editing
authors: Diego Royo, María Peña, Forrest B. Peterson, Andreas Velten, Julio Marco, Diego Gutierrez

title: PART：用 Transformer 学习三维部件装配与检索
title_en: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
abstract: 三维装配是现代制造与数字内容创作的基础。本文提出 PART——一个统一的、基于 Transformer 的三维部件检索与装配框架：给定目标形状与部件库，PART 自动挑选合适的部件并预测其 6 自由度位姿以重建目标。先前工作在装配一组预先给定的部件上取得了令人瞩目的进展，但这种更实用的、基于检索的设定仍很少被探索。该任务面临三个关键挑战：（i）搜索空间随部件库规模指数增长，呈组合爆炸；（ii）输出长度可变，不同目标需要不同数量的部件；（iii）装配需要连续的 6 自由度位姿估计。为应对这些挑战，我们把检索与装配表述为集合预测问题，并设计一个新颖的基于 Transformer 的框架，以可变长度输出完成部件检索与位姿回归。此外，我们通过联合训练与一个新颖的分割增强优化模块，利用部件位姿估计与目标分割之间的对偶性。最后，我们构建了包含 8 万多个形状的大规模数据集，结果表明 PART 可泛化到场景布局、图像目标与真实扫描。项目主页：https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/。
abstract_en: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans. Project Page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/.
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Ruchao Bao, Wenzheng Wu, Chucheng Xiang, Zhongyuan Liu, Yuan Liu, Jinxin Dong, Ligang Liu, Ziqi Wang

title: S4R：用于刚体互穿消解的尺度延拓方法
title_en: S4R: Scaling for Rigid-Body Interpenetration Resolution
abstract: 刚体互穿在程序化装配与生成的场景中频繁出现，必须在下游应用（如物理仿真）之前予以消除。我们提出 S4R（Scaling for Rigid-Body Interpenetration Resolution），一种用于静态互穿修复的尺度延拓方法。S4R 首先把每个物体围绕固定参考中心均匀收缩到很小的初始尺度，此时布局已无穿透；然后通过一系列最小范数凸接触二次规划（QP），在延拓过程中以线性化的分离裕度为优化目标，恢复到完整尺度。由此，消解过程把一次深度修正替换为一连串浅接触子问题。一个保守的尺度事件界与冻结见证（frozen-witness）间隙预测减少了精确网格查询的次数；延拓最后以全尺度评估器检查与有界尾部精化收尾。我们在 Kubric、HY3D-Bench 与 Thingi10K 上，用共享的网格级评估器与统一的逐场景计时协议评估 S4R。在三个基准的主要比较中，物体数量最高到 N=5000，S4R 在报告穿透为零的同时，位移保持很小且几乎与场景规模无关，并在各硬件档位内取得所比方法中最低的实际耗时。GPU 实现把这些结果扩展到大规模场景。代码与数据见项目主页：https://frank-zy-dou.github.io/projects/S4R/index.html。
abstract_en: Rigid-body interpenetration frequently occurs in procedurally assembled and generated scenes and must be removed before downstream applications such as physical simulation. We present S4R (Scaling for Rigid-Body Interpenetration Resolution), a scale-continuation method for static interpenetration repair. S4R first uniformly shrinks each body about a fixed reference center to a small initial scale, at which the layout is penetration-free, and then restores full scale through a sequence of minimum-norm convex contact quadratic programs (QPs) that target the linearized separation margin during continuation. Resolution thereby replaces one deep correction with a sequence of shallow-contact subproblems. A conservative scale-event bound and frozen-witness gap predictions cut the number of exact mesh queries; the continuation then ends with a full-scale evaluator check and bounded tail refinement. We evaluate S4R on Kubric, HY3D-Bench, and Thingi10K using a shared mesh-level evaluator and a unified per-scene timing protocol. In the main comparisons on all three benchmarks, up to N=5000 bodies, S4R reaches zero reported penetration with displacement that stays small and nearly independent of scene size, and at the lowest wall time within each hardware tier among the compared methods. A GPU implementation extends these results to large-scale scenes. Our code and data can be found on our project page: https://frank-zy-dou.github.io/projects/S4R/index.html.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Robotics;Avatar / Human;Physics Simulation;Geometry Processing
authors: Zhiyang Dou, Ang Zhao, Chen Peng, Minghao Guo, Haixu Wu, Cheng Lin, Yuan Liu, Junfeng Yao, Xiaohu Guo, Wenping Wang, Wojciech Matusik

title: 通过程序化策略搜索为连续游戏合成反应式角色行为
title_en: Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search
abstract: 我们提出一种方法，把连续游戏中的反应式角色行为合成为紧凑、人类可读的程序。游戏 AI 实践仍大量依赖手工编写的行为树、状态机与脚本，而学术界的强化学习通常产生不透明的神经控制器，训练昂贵且难以编辑。我们的方法弥合这一鸿沟：直接在一个面向连续空间游戏策略的领域特定语言上进行搜索。该语言围绕反应式几何决策设计，并包含方向最大化等高阶构造。这些构造有助于把连续的行为空间离散化为可枚举的程序结构。为使程序搜索实用化，我们引入大量合成反模式（antipattern），在保持行为覆盖的同时剔除冗余的程序形式。我们进一步把自底向上的符号枚举与来自编码智能体的自顶向下引导结合起来。所得方法称为“智能体式草图”（agentic sketching）：智能体提出高层策略结构，并调用枚举器补全局部程序空槽。我们在一个包含 14 个连续游戏的基准上评估该方法，覆盖从经典控制任务到多智能体足球。我们发现纯枚举往往比单用编码智能体更高效，而二者结合的方法则显著优于两者。结果表明，程序化策略搜索可以成为游戏 AI 的实用创作工具：设计者只需指定奖励函数，系统便能发现可编辑、可移植且常常出人意料的有效行为。
abstract_en: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.
keywords: Artificial Intelligence;Avatar / Human
authors: Maxim Gumin, Hsueh-Ti Derek Liu, Victor Zordan, Daniel Ritchie

title: PartLLM：面向三维部件分割的统一多模态基础模型
title_en: PartLLM: A Unified Multimodal Foundation for 3D Part Segmentation
abstract: 部件分割是计算机图形学与三维视觉的基础问题。近期工作把三维部件分割拓展到固定分类体系之外，但现有方法通常只处理某一特定设定，例如文本引导的部件分割或基于点的交互。本文认为，这些设定可以统一为一个“意图条件化的生成问题”——不同提示只是指定了期望的部件分解方式。为此，我们提出 PartLLM，一个统一的多模态模型，把三维部件分割表述为自回归的语义分解。以输入形状与用户提示为条件，PartLLM 自回归地生成语义部件假设，作为掩码预测的查询，并送入一个分解感知解码器联合预测连贯的部件掩码。这一统一设计在单一模型中同时支持文本引导的部件分割、交互式分割以及粒度可控的全形状语义分解。在这些任务设定上的大量实验表明，PartLLM 一致优于任务专用基线，证明了在意图条件化生成表述下统一三维部件分割的有效性。
abstract_en: Part segmentation is a fundamental problem in computer graphics and 3D vision. Recent works have expanded 3D part segmentation beyond fixed taxonomies, but existing approaches typically only address a specific setting, such as text-guided part segmentation or point-based interaction. In this work, we argue that these settings can be unified as an intent-conditioned generative problem, where different prompts specify the desired part decomposition. To this end, we introduce PartLLM, a unified multimodal model that formulates 3D part segmentation as autoregressive semantic decomposition. Conditioned on an input shape and a user prompt, PartLLM autoregressively generates semantic part hypotheses as queries for mask prediction and feeds them to a decomposition-aware decoder that jointly predicts coherent part masks. This unified design supports text-guided part segmentation, interactive segmentation, and full-shape semantic decomposition with controllable granularity within a single model. Extensive experiments across these task settings show that PartLLM consistently outperforms task-specific baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unifying 3D part segmentation under an intent-conditioned generative formulation.
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Zhe Zhu, Yiheng Zhang, Peng Li, Zixing Zhao, Honghua Chen, Yaqing Zhang, Le Wan, Zhiyang Dou, Cheng Lin, Yuan Liu, Mingqiang Wei, Wenping Wang

title: 面向旋转稳定 360° 场景理解的规范等变注意力
title_en: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable 360° Scene Understanding
abstract: 全景 360° 场景理解日益依赖二十面体球面 Transformer，但一个最先进的球面模型在相机旋转 90° 时会损失一半以上的分割精度；受控消融表明，其相对位置偏置中的规范（gauge）依赖是主要原因之一。我们提出规范等变相对位置编码（GE-RPE）：在规范旋转的有限循环子群 Cₙ⊂SO(2) 上对该偏置取无参数的 Reynolds 平均。把它接入 SphereUFormer 骨干后，部署时的变化几乎不可见——零新增参数、前向时延仅增加 1.5–4.4%——而匹配的三随机种子 GE-RPE 模型仅出现 1.3% 的下降；已发表的 SphereUFormer 检查点在同一压力协议下（训练配方不同）下降达 53%。一旦去除规范缺陷，并用教师 token 置换 π_R 把自监督学习的视角对齐到旋转后的学生坐标系，iBOT+MAE 预训练便不再是负担，而成为一个干净的少标注杠杆：完整框架 EquiSSL（GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE）把下降收窄至 0.8%，验证 mIoU 达 68.30%，并在 N=373 测试划分上把 1% 标注微调提升 +2.39 mIoU（在更小的 N=40 验证划分上提升 +4.10）；同一修正还可迁移到单目深度与零样本 Structured3D 分割。该构造可证明是 Cₙ 不变的，且与连续 SO(2) 平均的偏差为 O(n⁻²) 量级，使所得模型成为可用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移的 360° 视觉计算基础件。代码见 https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release。
abstract_en: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Relighting;Lighting / Illumination;3D Reconstruction;Segmentation / Understanding;Depth Estimation
authors: Tianjian Zhou, Yishan Li, Jie Jiang, Yifei Zhang

title: 通过簇转移图的变长神经动作拼接
title_en: Length-varying Neural Motion Stitching via Cluster Transition Graph
abstract: 动作拼接旨在把已有动作序列无缝组合成新的角色动画。现有方法往往需要人工选择过渡区间，或假设过渡长度固定，限制了可连接的动作类型。为拓宽可合成的动作多样性，关键在于生成不同长度的过渡，使角色在输入动作差异较大时有足够时间调整姿态。为此，我们提出一种基于簇转移图的变长神经动作拼接方法，可在给定两段不同输入动作时产生自然连接的动作序列。框架包含三个阶段：动作聚类、簇路径搜索与动作生成。首先，动作聚类把输入动作映射为离散簇；接着，我们在簇转移图中定位对应簇并搜索连接路径，图中节点表示动作簇，有向边表示簇之间的有效过渡；所得路径既决定过渡长度，也给出一条指导动作生成的引导序列；最后，把路径与输入动作送入基于 Transformer 编码器的动作生成器，产出最终的过渡姿态。实验结果表明，本方法能自适应调整动作长度，并在诸如爬行、投篮与慢速移动等差异很大的动作之间成功生成合理过渡。我们还表明，相比假设固定过渡长度或直接计算时间的方法，使用图结构能有效估计过渡时长并产生高保真结果。
abstract_en: Motion stitching aims to create new character animations by seamlessly combining existing motion sequences. Existing approaches often require manual selection of transition range or assume fixed transition length, restricting the types of motions that can be connected. To broaden the diversity of motions that can be synthesized, it is essential to generate transitions of varying lengths, allowing the character sufficient time to adapt its pose when the input motions differ significantly. To this end, we propose a length-varying neural motion stitching method based on a cluster transition graph, which produces naturally connected motion sequences given two distinct input motions. Our framework consists of three stages: motion clustering, cluster pathfinding, and motion generation. First, motion clustering maps input motions to discrete clusters. Next, we identify the corresponding clusters in the cluster transition graph and search for a connecting path. In this graph, nodes represent motion clusters, and directed edges indicate valid transitions between them. The resulting path determines both the transition length and a guide sequence that informs motion generation. Finally, the path and input motions are provided to a Transformer encoder-based motion generator to produce the final transition poses. Experimental results demonstrate that our method adaptively adjusts the motion length and successfully generates plausible transitions between distinct motions, such as crawling, basketball shooting, and slow locomotion. We also show that using a graph structure effectively estimates transition durations and produces high-fidelity results compared to methods that assume a fixed transition length, or directly compute the time.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion
authors: Haemin Kim, Junghyun Nam, Seokhyeon Hong, Vanessa Tan, Junyong Noh

title: DecomVoxel：利用三维原生先验与引导式原位去噪优化进行分解式场景重建
title_en: DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction
abstract: 分解式场景重建旨在重建高质量的物体与背景，但现有方法在严重遮挡下的质量仍不理想。生成先验提供了潜在解法，然而基于二维图像的先验因缺乏三维感知，常出现多视角不一致；相反，三维原生先验具有更强的结构归纳偏置，却常常在复杂场景中导致空间漂移与错位。为应对这些问题，我们提出 DecomVoxel，把物体补全表述为一种引导式原位去噪优化，从而把三维原生先验与神经场景重建连接起来。我们的框架引入一种重新表述的、基于 epsilon 的蒸馏损失以确保潜变量精化的稳定性，并配合自适应空间引导——利用占据与空闲锚点并施加时间退火——来抑制生成幻觉、缓解空间漂移。在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上的实验表明，DecomVoxel 显著优于当前最优方法，同时忠实保持原有空间布局、结构保真度与风格一致的纹理。本方法以干净拓扑的高质量带纹理网格（几何与外观俱佳）拓展了分解式重建的边界，为复杂真实场景的分解式重建提供了稳健方案。代码见 https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel。
abstract_en: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.
keywords: Computer Vision;3D Reconstruction;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Junfeng Ni, Zirui Zhou, Yixin Chen, Yu Liu, Nan Jiang, Zhifei Yang, Song-Chun Zhu, Siyuan Huang

title: PIE-PS：从物理辐照度事件流进行光度立体
title_en: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
abstract: 事件相机以微秒级延迟与高动态范围异步记录对数图像辐照度的变化。这些特性对运动光照下的光度立体很有用，但原始事件是稀疏的，且依赖未知的对比度阈值。我们从事件触发模型出发，推导出相邻事件、光照运动与表面法线之间的物理关系。该关系给出一个纯物理的直接求解器，但该求解器需要阈值、需要每个像素有足够多的事件，并且需要逐像素独立优化。为应对这些限制，我们提出 PIE-PS，一个从原始事件流与已知光照重建稠密表面法线的学习框架。我们通过把同一像素上两个相邻事件与其对应的光照方向配对，构造“物理辐照度事件”（PIE）。每个 PIE 给出一个物理辐照度事件特征（PIEF），定义为带符号的事件率。PIEF 不需要未知的对比度阈值。为在邻近 PIE 之间共享空间与时间上下文，我们引入 PIE-GNN：它把每个 PIE 视为图节点，并用其光照对几何进行编码。由于 PIE 观测的可靠性会随局部外观、光照几何与传感器噪声而变化，可靠性分级注意力（RGA）预测可靠性权重，以降低不可靠 PIE 的权重。随后经像素聚合得到稠密法线。在合成与真实数据上的实验表明，PIE-PS 优于此前基于事件的光度立体方法与直接求解器基线。
abstract_en: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.
keywords: Computer Vision;Lighting / Illumination;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Animation / Motion;Geometry Processing;Image Generation / Editing
authors: Xiangze Meng, Guangyu Li, Jing Li, Di Mei, Songchen Ma, Mingkun Xu, Rui Ma

title: Tabula Rasa：可控时空相关的单位方差噪声的蒙特卡洛估计
title_en: Tabula Rasa: Monte Carlo estimation of unit-variance noise with controlled spatio-temporal correlation
abstract: 我们提出一种生成方差可控、时间相关性可控的时变高斯噪声的方法。这类噪声在若干下游任务中被用于时间控制与时间连贯性。核心技术思路是把该问题表述为：借助数据库文献中的“sketching”概念，对经典像素重建与方差估计进行联合蒙特卡洛估计。我们证明，相比此前方法，本方法能以更简单、更快的代码为下游任务提供时间控制。
abstract_en: We suggest a method to generate time-varying Gaussian noise with controlled variance and controlled temporal correlation. This noise is used in several downstream tasks for temporal control and temporal coherence. The core technical idea is to phrase this problem as joint Monte-Carlo estimation of both a classic pixel reconstruction and estimation of variance using the concept of "sketching" from the database literature. We demonstrate that our method allows temporal control for downstream tasks with simpler and faster code than previous methods.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Computer Vision;3D Reconstruction;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Tobias Ritschel, Yang Zhou, Nick Milef, Mikhail Dereviannykh, Chen Liu, Christophe Hery, Carl Marshall

title: AuraLuxMuse：音乐与专家引导下美学舞台灯光设计的自适应融合建模
title_en: AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance
abstract: 我们提出 AuraLuxMuse——一个用于自动化美学舞台灯光设计的新系统，它融合专家知识、表示学习与偏好自适应建模。现场演出中的灯光设计需要把音乐特征无缝转化为动态灯光行为，然而传统工作流耗时、费力且难以迁移。AuraLuxMuse 把音乐与专业灯光提示序列编码进共享检索空间，估计提示—事件密度，并把选定的灯具指令重定向到目标舞台。它通过返回可编辑的灯光提示来辅助前期创作，而不是用一个无约束的生成器取代设计师。AuraLuxMuse 的核心是两个关键模块：光照对齐的音乐预训练（LAMP），在音频与灯光提示之间做对比学习以实现对齐；以及偏好自适应专家混合（PAMoE），通过风格特定专家网络的门控集成，把偏好感知的提示检索与适配条件化于设计师意图。为支撑训练与评测，我们提出 Musilux——首个在多样演出场景下配对音乐音频与专业灯光提示序列的数据集。我们在虚拟仿真环境与专业级实验室中对 AuraLuxMuse 进行评估。包含客观与主观评测的实验结果表明，AuraLuxMuse 检索并适配出的舞台灯光提示在视觉上协调、语义上有意义、艺术上有表现力，展现了 AI 辅助美学舞台设计的潜力。
abstract_en: We present AuraLuxMuse, a novel system for automated aesthetic stage lighting design that integrates expert knowledge, representation learning, and preference-adaptive modeling. Lighting design in live performance settings requires the seamless translation of musical features into dynamic lighting behaviors. However, traditional workflows remain time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to transfer. AuraLuxMuse encodes music and professional cue sequences into a shared retrieval space, estimates cue-event density, and retargets selected fixture commands to the destination stage. It assists pre-production authoring by returning editable cues rather than replacing the designer with an unconstrained generator. At the heart of AuraLuxMuse are two key modules: Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP), which performs contrastive learning between audio and lighting cues for alignment, and Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE), which conditions preference-aware cue retrieval and adaptation on designers' intent through a gated ensemble of style-specific expert networks. To support training and evaluation, we introduce Musilux, the first dataset of paired musical audio and professional lighting cue sequences under diverse performance scenarios. We evaluate AuraLuxMuse across both virtual simulation environments and professional-grade laboratories. Experimental results, including objective and subjective evaluation, demonstrate that AuraLuxMuse retrieves and adapts stage-lighting cues that are visually cohesive, semantically meaningful, and artistically expressive, showing its potential for AI-assisted aesthetic stage design.
keywords: Multimedia;Artificial Intelligence;Lighting / Illumination;Animation / Motion;Physics Simulation;CAD / Modeling
authors: Junyu Deng, Jiale Cao, Mengtian Li, Zhongxia Ji, Ruhua Chen, Yiyi He, Guangnan Ye, Zuo Hu

title: HoOPOE：一种面向全息的优化感知目标函数
title_en: HoOPOE: A Holography-Optimized Perceptual ObjectivE function
abstract: 全息设备必须在有限数量的空间光调制器（SLM）像素下重建整个光场，且只能依靠相干照明下的标量波衍射来实现。因此，计算机生成全息（CGH）常出现散斑伪影。我们提出 HoOPOE（Holography-Optimized Perceptual ObjectivE function，全息优化的感知目标函数）——一个 CGH 专用的、感知感知的损失函数，可让散斑从人眼视觉中“隐去”。HoOPOE 对 CGH 优化有效，是因为它考虑了人眼视觉系统对时空频率与颜色的敏感性，且其参数经过调节以最大化其作为 CGH 损失函数的性能。我们用 HoOPOE 为基于网格生成的焦栈生成全息图，随后通过用户研究把 HoOPOE 生成的全息图与现有损失函数的结果做基准比较。HoOPOE 给出视觉上最悦目的结果；平均而言，用户在 68% 的情况下更偏好 HoOPOE 而非次优的目标函数。
abstract_en: Holographic devices must reconstruct an entire light field given a finite number of spatial light modulator (SLM) pixels, and must do so using scalar-wave diffraction from coherent illumination alone. As a result, computer-generated holography (CGH) often has speckling artifacts. We propose HoOPOE (Holography-Optimized Perceptual ObjectivE function), a CGH-specific, perceptually-aware loss function that hides speckles from human vision. HoOPOE is effective for CGH optimizations because it accounts for the human visual system's sensitivity to spatio-temporal frequencies and color, and its parameters are tuned to maximize its performance as a loss function for CGH. We use HoOPOE to generate holograms for mesh-derived focal stacks. We then conduct a user study to benchmark HoOPOE-generated holograms against existing loss functions. HoOPOE yields the most visually pleasing results; users prefer HoOPOE 68% of the time over the next best objective function on average.
keywords: Computer Graphics;Lighting / Illumination;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Optics / Display
authors: Ethan Chen, Xi Peng, Alexandre Chapiro, Dario Seyb, Michael Grundmann, Carl Marshall, Sushant Kondguli, Praneeth Chakravarthula, Yuhao Zhu

title: X-Splat：面向 RGB 与 X 射线联合三维重建的统一高斯泼溅
title_en: X-Splat: Unified Gaussian Splatting for Joint RGB and X-ray 3D Reconstruction
abstract: 联合重建 RGB 与 X 射线，能够把外部外观与内部结构联系起来，从而比单一模态更完整地理解真实物体。然而现有方法为每个模态训练独立模型，受制于冗余几何、对齐伪影与耦合松散，限制了跨模态洞察的发现。我们提出一种统一表示：所有高斯基元共享同一套几何参数，只有靠近表面的基元额外携带外观属性。我们通过干净的多视角立体与 X 射线几何代理来完成跨模态配准，而不是对齐两组各自优化出的高斯，从而提升对齐稳定性。随后我们借助两个模态的监督联合优化该统一表示，并辅以由 X 射线几何导出的表面深度一致性损失来引导 RGB 重建。在 InsideOut 数据集与我们自建的 Flower & Insect 数据集上的实验表明，本框架实现了更稳健的跨模态对齐、在不损害 X 射线重建的前提下取得更高的 RGB 渲染质量，并且相比维护两套独立几何具有更紧凑的表示。
abstract_en: Jointly reconstructing RGB and X-ray provides new insights by connecting external appearance with internal structure, enabling a more complete understanding of real-world objects than single modality. Yet existing methods train separate models per modality and suffer from redundant geometry, alignment artifacts, and loose coupling that limits cross-modal insight discovery. We propose a unified representation in which all Gaussian primitives share a single set of geometric parameters, with only surface-proximal primitives additionally carrying appearance attributes. We perform cross-modal registration through clean multi-view stereo and X-ray geometric proxies instead of aligning two sets of optimized Gaussians, improving alignment stability. We then jointly optimize the unified representation via supervision from both modalities, complemented by a surface-depth consistency loss derived from X-ray geometry to guide RGB reconstruction. Experiments on the InsideOut dataset and our Flower & Insect dataset show that our framework achieves more robust cross-modal alignment, higher RGB rendering quality without compromising X-ray reconstruction, and a more compact representation than maintaining two independent geometries.
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Gaussian Splatting;3D Reconstruction;Avatar / Human;Geometry Processing;Rendering / Sampling;Segmentation / Understanding
