title: SwitchSplat：从随手拍摄场景中学习离散物体状态
title_en: SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes
abstract: 三维高斯泼溅让高保真三维重建变得快速且易得，但现有表示都假设世界是静态的。这一假设在随手拍摄中失效：用户会自然地与环境交互——开门、拨动开关或移动物体——引入当前任何框架都无法建模的离散状态变化。诸如 4DGS 这类时间条件化的动态方法，把“状态是在何时被观测到的”与“场景处于何种状态”混为一谈，因而只能回放已见序列，无法组合任意的物体配置。我们提出 SwitchSplat，首个通过“基础 + 槽位”（base+slot）分解来填补这一空白的三维高斯表示：共享的静态基础捕捉不变的场景，每个槽位则独立持有一个可交互物体的两种二值状态（开/关）。由于高斯到槽位的分配完全可微，模型能直接从视频中发现每种状态的几何，无需人工标注。推理时，用户可自由组合各槽位状态，并从任意视角渲染所得场景。我们在一个新的随手拍摄数据集上验证 SwitchSplat，结果表明它在新视角合成质量上优于静态与动态基线，并独有地支持渲染采集过程中从未见过的状态组合。项目主页：https://switchsplat.github.io
abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io
keywords: Computer Vision;Computer Graphics;Gaussian Splatting;3D Reconstruction;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Yizheng Xie, Yalda Foroutan, George Shramko, Daniel Rebain, Shrisudhan Govindarajan, Andrea Tagliasacchi

title: GALA：面向可控物体摆放的几何感知语言模型
title_en: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
abstract: 对支撑、容纳等细粒度摆放约束进行推理，是创建真实感三维场景的关键。现有方法依赖有向包围盒（OBB）这类简化物体表示，对细节几何“视而不见”，因而这仍是一大挑战。为突破这一局限，我们提出 GALA——一个具备显式点云感知、用于可控物体摆放的几何感知语言模型。该模型以场景上下文与摆放指令为条件，一次自回归地预测一个目标物体的 6D 位姿。我们采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段通过预训练任务对齐几何与文本模态，第二阶段针对摆放任务微调模型。为支撑该任务，我们还构建了一个多源场景数据集，覆盖多样房间类型与细粒度家具布置，并将开源以惠及社区。在我们基准上的实验表明，该模型显著优于不具备显式几何推理的基线。我们还开发了一条多阶段的“规划—摆放—校验”智能体流水线，用该模型完成文本驱动的场景生成。项目主页：https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/
abstract_en: Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. To facilitate this task, we also curate a multi-source scene dataset covering diverse room types and fine-grained furniture arrangements, which will be open-sourced for community benefit. Experiments on our benchmark show our model significantly outperforms baselines without explicit geometric reasoning. We further develop a multi-stage plan-place-verify agent pipeline that uses the model for text-driven scene generation. Project Page: https://xccelephant.github.io/paper/gala/
keywords: Computer Graphics;Artificial Intelligence;Computer Vision;Segmentation / Understanding
authors: Chucheng Xiang, Runze Wang, Zhi Deng, Ruchao Bao, Yuanwei Zhang, Yuxuan Xie, Hanliu Wang, Liangzhen Fei, Wenzheng Wu, Cheng Wan, Peifeng Li, Zhongyuan Liu, Ligang Liu

title: RealMe：从极简采集生成沉浸式体积视频
title_en: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
abstract: 本文研究如何从稀疏、低分辨率的采集资源创建沉浸式体积视频。传统稠密多视角重建方法能产出高质量体积视频，但其对昂贵采集装置的依赖使其在真实场景中不切实际。近期方法用生成模型放宽采集要求，却仍受限于分辨率不足与四维不一致。为克服这些约束，我们提出 RealMe——一个围绕高分辨率视频扩散模型构建的统一框架，把有限的采集增强为高分辨率（2K）、四维一致的视频，用于体积视频重建。具体而言，RealMe 从采集视频构造辅助数据，并把它们与布局感知的位置嵌入一起编码为潜变量。视频扩散模型把分解的时空注意力适配到多视角采集布局上，跨视角与时间对这些潜变量去噪，再解码为增强视频以精化四维表示。这种适配帮助模型捕捉时间动态与多视角关系，从而生成更具四维一致性的结果。为缩小生成视频与真实采集之间的数据鸿沟，我们施加潜频域损失，在潜空间中提供频域监督。在公开的 DNA-Rendering 基准与我们自采的 RealVV 数据集上的大量实验表明，RealMe 能够创建沉浸式体积视频，并在视觉保真度与四维一致性上优于当前最优方法。
abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.
keywords: Computer Vision;Diffusion Model;3D Reconstruction;Physics Simulation;Rendering / Sampling
authors: Chenxu Zhou, Zhiyuan Yu, Yudong Jin, Yinji Shentu, Yu Zhang, Jiaming Sun, Xiaowei Zhou
